units.text: 마차에서 빵이 떨어졌다.
리아는 난간 밖으로 손을 뻗었다가 거두었다. 빵은 빗줄기 사이로 작아지더니 계곡 밑의 흰 물살에 삼켜졌다. 그 위에서 마차 바퀴가 한 번 더 기울었다.
“사람 있어요?”
“둘! 안에 애 하나!”
마부석의 여자가 소리쳤다. 한 손으로 고삐를 잡고, 다른 손으로 짐 덮개를 들추려 했다. 덮개 아래에서 작은 주먹이 불룩 튀어나왔다.
동쪽 끝까지는 마차 한 대가 겨우 들어갈 거리였다. 말의 앞발은 땅에 닿아 있었지만 뒤에 매인 수레가 말까지 끌어당겼다. 길목에는 말보다 큰 사슴이 서 있었다. 젖은 뿔이 바위처럼 검었다.
리아는 서쪽 난간에 묶인 통행 금지 끈을 넘었다. 가방을 앞으로 돌리자 크림색 털뭉치가 덮개를 밀고 나왔다. 비를 맞은 둥근 귀가 순식간에 납작해졌다.
“보리, 조금만 참아.”
보리는 리아의 손가락을 밀어내고 다시 숨었다. 다만 가방 밖에 남은 긴 꼬리는 끌어 넣지 못했다. 리아는 젖은 꼬리 끝을 안으로 넣어 준 뒤 마차를 향해 뛰었다.
뒤에서 도윤이 따라왔다. 판자가 울릴 때마다 그의 시선은 발밑과 난간의 고정점을 오갔다.
“리아. 받치고 나면?”
“사람 나오면 놓으면 돼.”
“너 나올 자리도 봐.”

The carriage wheel tilts once more, returning attention from the lost bread to the people still above the gorge.

The call about occupants receives the driver's urgent answer. Keeping one hand on the reins, she tries to lift the cover; a child's fist presses up beneath it. Establish the rescue targets before Lia advances.

Lia crosses the western closure cord and brings her bag around to the front. Bori pushes out through its flap, and the rain immediately flattens the small animal's round ears. Lia asks Bori to endure a little longer.
Bori pushes Lia's fingers away and hides again, leaving the long tail outside. Lia puts its wet tip into the bag, completing the brief act of care.
With Bori tucked inside, Lia runs toward the endangered carriage.
Doyun follows. The sounding planks prompt repeated checks of the surface beneath him and the railing's attachment points, showing his attention to their return route.

Doyun explicitly includes Lia in the people who must get out. Let this concern close the scene while the physical danger remains unresolved.

facts.statement: Bread falls from the carriage. Lia reaches beyond the railing and withdraws her hand. The bread disappears into white water below, and a carriage wheel tilts again.
The woman at the driver's seat reports two people, including a child inside. She holds the reins with one hand and tries to lift the cargo cover with the other. A small fist bulges beneath the cover.
The remaining distance to the eastern end is described as barely sufficient for one carriage. The horse's front hooves touch ground, while the carriage attached behind pulls on the horse.
A deer larger than the horse stands in the route. Its wet antlers are black like rock. No attack occurs in the excerpt.

Lia crosses a closure cord tied to the western railing. Bori emerges from her bag, reacts to the rain, pushes away her fingers and retreats. Lia tucks the exposed tail inside before running toward the carriage.
Doyun follows Lia. Whenever the planks sound, his gaze moves between his footing and the railing's attachment points.
Doyun asks what happens after Lia provides support. She says she can release it once the people get out. He tells her to consider her own way out.

units.text: 리아는 대답 대신 무릎을 꿇었다. 손바닥 앞에 작은 청록빛 면이 펴졌다. 투명한 방패를 기운 차축 밑으로 밀어 넣고 팔을 세웠다.
마차가 멎었다.
그 한순간에, 할 수 있다고 생각했다.
곧 팔꿈치가 꺾였다. 짐의 무게가 어깨까지 내려앉고 무릎 아래 판자가 푹 꺼졌다. 빛의 가장자리에 하얀 금이 갔다. 방패가 버티면 자신이 다리를 뚫고 떨어질 판이었다.
“괜찮아요. 빨리 애부터…….”
목소리가 끝에서 새었다.
여자가 리아의 팔을 보더니 고삐를 도윤에게 내밀었다.
“말을 먼저 풀어 줘요. 버티는 동안.”
도윤은 마차 옆 난간을 붙잡고 동쪽으로 몸을 넘겼다. 땅에 발을 딛자 칼로 멍에의 가죽끈을 끊었다. 자유로워진 말이 튀어나가려 하자 고삐를 짧게 잡아 왼쪽 바위턱으로 이끌었다. 사슴은 오른쪽 길목에서 뿔을 들었지만 따라붙지는 않았다.
마차를 앞으로 당기던 힘이 사라졌다. 리아의 손목이 더 깊이 젖혀졌다.
“얼마나 버텨?”
도윤이 동쪽 바위에 줄을 두르며 물었다.
“사람 나올 때까지.”
그는 고개를 들었다. 리아는 눈을 피했다. 자기도 모르는 시간을 말해 버렸다.

Still holding, Lia minimizes her distress and urges immediate help for the child. Her reassurance loses breath at its unfinished ending.

Lia briefly believes she can do it. Her elbow then buckles, the cargo's weight bears down through her shoulder, the plank beneath her knees sinks, and white cracks appear along the light's edge. Even if the shield holds, she risks falling through the bridge.
Lia says she is all right and urges that the child be helped first. Her voice trails away at the end.
The woman looks at Lia's arm, extends the reins to Doyun, and asks him to free the horse first while Lia holds.
Doyun grips the railing beside the carriage, climbs over toward the east, reaches the ground, and cuts the yoke's leather strap with his sword.
The freed horse tries to bolt. Doyun shortens his hold on the reins and guides it toward the left rock ledge. The deer raises its antlers at the right-hand approach but does not follow.
The force pulling the carriage forward disappears. Lia's wrist bends farther backward.

units.text: 여자가 덮개를 젖혔다. 소년 하나가 밀가루 자루 사이에 끼어 있었다. 리아의 길드 표찰을 보자 아이의 입술이 떨렸다.
“저, 내려도 돼요?”
“발만 빼면 돼. 이름은 나중에 말해.”
리아는 왼손으로 아이 가까이에 두 번째 방패를 폈다. 작게 기운 빛의 면이 아이와 마차 가장자리 사이를 메웠다. 멀리 놓을 수는 없었다. 손을 뻗은 만큼만, 한 발을 옮길 자리만 만들 수 있었다.
아이가 짐을 밀자 밀가루 자루들이 한꺼번에 오른쪽으로 쏠렸다.
첫 방패가 갈라졌다.
리아는 이를 악물었다. 조금만 더 버티면 짐도 살릴 수 있었다. 저 자루들이 동쪽에서 며칠 치 식사가 되는지, 아까 길목에서 의뢰를 받을 때 들었다.
“마렌 씨. 위의 상자만 뒤로 밀면…….”
“뒤도 바닥이 없어요.”
마렌이 자기 허리에서 칼을 뽑았다.
“애야. 내 옷 잡아.”
그녀는 기다리지 않고 자루를 묶은 끈을 잘랐다. 밀가루가 덮개를 밀고 계곡으로 쏟아졌다. 흰 가루가 비에 퍼졌다가 사라졌다. 마렌은 떨어지는 짐을 끝까지 보지 않고 소년의 발목을 빼냈다.
갑자기 가벼워진 차축이 방패 위에서 들썩였다. 리아는 그 틈에 오른팔을 빼고 무릎을 폈다. 손끝이 저렸다.

plan.intent: Keep one continuous rescue under mounting strain. Lia makes room for the trapped boy while trying to preserve food that people in the east need. His attempt to move shifts the cargo and cracks her first shield. Maren recognizes that moving the cargo backward is impossible and sacrifices it to free him. Make her practical decision the turning point: the lost flour releases the boy's ankle and gives Lia an opportunity to withdraw her arm. End with that immediate relief and its physical cost, without extending the scene into a completed evacuation.
plan.staging: Create one finished full-color fantasy comic scene with expressive ink lines and seven generous, legible panels in a natural vertical reading flow. The nine beats are events, not panel assignments; let the artist group them and choose compositions. Maintain the rainy gorge bridge and endangered carriage. Establish the boy among the flour sacks, Maren close enough to reach the binding cord and his ankle, and Lia close enough to place the second shield between him and the carriage edge with her left hand. Keep the two small turquoise shields distinct: the existing shield supports the axle, while the second makes limited room beside the boy. Make the axle's contact with the first shield and Lia's bodily strain readable; the previous review identifies a vertical wall depiction that obscured this support. Preserve the visible cracking without depicting the supporting shield as completely gone before the axle jolts on it. Keep the sacks' rightward shift consistent without assigning it an unsupported compass direction. Show the knife cutting the binding cord, followed by the flour falling into the gorge and Maren freeing the ankle. Maintain Lia as an adult woman with dark chestnut hair, amber eyes, and faint nose freckles; Maren as an adult woman with dark auburn curls, brown eyes, and a round face; and the boy as a child. Follow accessible finished references for clothing and props. Bori needs no new action or reveal, and Doyun needs no new intervention. Render only the selected verbatim Korean text inside the image, with every dialogue balloon clearly attached to its assigned speaker. Preserve third-person limited access through Lia's captions and portray Maren's choice through observable actions. Stop after Lia withdraws her arm and straightens her knees.

beats.action: Maren lifts the cover and exposes the boy trapped among the sacks. His attention catches on Lia's guild badge and his lips tremble. He asks permission to get down; Lia immediately directs him to free his foot, postponing his name. Retain the question as an event, with its lettering omission explained under uncertainties.

While maintaining the existing support, Lia extends her left hand and forms the second small shield beside the boy. Establish the limited space it makes for a single foot movement and the short reach that prevents her from placing it farther away.
The boy pushes the cargo to move. The sacks shift together to the right, followed by the first shield cracking. Keep the shifting load and the worsening shield legible as successive events.

Lia grits her teeth and continues holding. Her knowledge of the meals represented by the flour explains why she still wants to save the cargo along with the boy. Keep this recollection within the ongoing rescue rather than cutting to a flashback.
Lia begins a proposal to move the upper box backward. Maren answers that there is no floor behind either, closing off the proposed maneuver before anyone attempts it.
Maren draws the knife from her waist and tells the boy to hold her clothes. Let the ordinary tool and immediate instruction make her decision understandable through action.

Maren acts without waiting and cuts the cord binding the sacks. The released flour pushes the cover and pours into the gorge. Establish the cut before the spill without adding an unstated mechanism for how the sacks open.

White flour disperses in the rain. Maren turns her attention away before the cargo finishes falling and frees the boy's ankle. Keep the material loss and her choice of the child connected in the same continuous action.

With the load suddenly reduced, the axle jolts on the shield. Lia seizes the opening to pull out her right arm and straighten her knees. End on her tingling fingertips and the immediate release of strain.

facts.statement: The woman lifts the cover, revealing a boy wedged among flour sacks. His lips tremble when he sees Lia's guild badge. He asks whether he may get down; Lia tells him to free his foot and leave introductions until later.

Lia creates a second shield with her left hand near the boy. The small, tilted plane of light fills the space between him and the carriage edge. Its reach is limited to her outstretched hand and enough room to move one foot.
When the boy pushes the cargo, the flour sacks shift together to the right. The first shield cracks.

Lia grits her teeth and believes that holding a little longer could save the cargo too. When accepting the job, she learned how many days of meals the sacks represent in the east. She begins proposing that Maren push only the upper box backward.
Maren says there is no floor behind either, draws a knife from her waist, and tells the boy to hold her clothes.

Without waiting, Maren cuts the cord binding the sacks. Flour pushes against the cover and pours into the gorge. White powder spreads through the rain and disappears. Maren does not watch the falling cargo to the end; she frees the boy's ankle.
The suddenly lightened axle jolts on the shield. Lia uses that opening to withdraw her right arm and straighten her knees. Her fingertips tingle.

brief.style: Finished full-color fantasy comic; expressive ink, seven generous panels, natural vertical reading, rainy gorge bridge, established clothing and props, verbatim Korean lettering.

moments.action: Maren holds the cover above the boy wedged among flour sacks. His parted, trembling lips face Lia's guild badge. Maren has dark auburn curls, brown eyes, and a round adult face.

Adult Lia, with dark chestnut hair, holds her left hand beside a small tilted turquoise shield between boy and carriage edge; her braced right arm holds the separate turquoise shield against the axle's underside.
The boy's hands remain pressed against sacks displaced rightward. The axle's support shield has a fresh crack; Lia grits her teeth, amber eyes strained above faint nose freckles.
Maren holds her drawn knife near the binding cord, facing the trapped boy; Lia remains braced beneath the axle.
Maren's knife severs the cord binding the flour sacks.
Maren holds the boy's freed ankle; flour spills past the displaced cover into the gorge, dispersing through rain, while she looks at the child.
Lia stands with knees straight, right arm withdrawn, and fingertips visible beside the lightened axle quivering on its cracked support shield.

units.text: “나가요. 왼쪽 빛 밟고.”
소년이 방패 위로 한 발을 내디뎠다. 빛이 신발 밑에서 떨렸다. 리아는 팔을 내리지 않은 채 아이와 함께 옆으로 걸었다. 동쪽 땅에 선 도윤이 손을 뻗어 아이를 끌어 올렸다.
아이가 바위에 주저앉았다. 두 발이 모두 땅에 있었다.
그걸 보자 리아도 숨을 한 번 쉴 수 있었다.
하지만 마렌이 일어서는 순간, 빈 짐칸 아래에서 굵은 철물 묶음이 굴렀다. 마차가 옆으로 돌아가며 오른쪽 난간을 잡아당겼다. 끊어진 난간 줄이 사슴 발치에 떨어졌다.
사슴이 뒷걸음질쳤다. 바위벽 때문에 더 물러나지 못한 몸이 돌았고, 넓은 뿔이 다리 입구를 향했다.
도윤이 소년을 자기 뒤로 밀었다. 칼끝이 낮아졌다.
리아는 마렌의 팔을 붙잡았다. 아직 두 걸음이 남았다. 그 사이 판자 하나가 물로 떨어졌다.
가방 안에서 보리가 날카롭게 울었다.
리아가 덮개를 올리자 작은 앞발이 손등을 짚었다. 부푼 털 사이에서 금빛 불꽃이 튀었다. 보리의 시선은 사슴이 아니라, 그 옆에 늘어진 쇠사슬을 향해 있었다. 쇠사슬 끝은 물웅덩이에 잠겼다가 사슴이 발을 옮길 때마다 드러났다.
번개담비는 전기가 흐를 자리를 사람보다 먼저 알아챘다. 그러나 보리가 낼 수 있는 것은 가까운 곳을 따끔하게 때릴 짧은 번개뿐이었다. 사슴을 쓰러뜨릴 힘은 없었다.

plan.intent: Give the boy's completed rescue a brief, concrete payoff before the shifting wagon threatens the remaining escape. Keep each person's protective action legible as the danger changes. End with Bori noticing the chain and a possible path for electricity, while making clear that Bori's limited power cannot bring down the deer. The discovery creates an unresolved possibility, not a completed solution.

The artist chooses compositions, panel proportions, and viewpoints. The ten beats are events rather than panel assignments. Use the selected instants to keep one temporal state per panel: the handover culminates the crossing; grounded relief follows separately; the rolling ironwork precedes the wagon-and-rope consequence. Combine the deer's completed turn with Doyun's protective position, and combine Lia's continuing grip with the aftermath of the plank fall and Bori's closed-bag cry. The opened-bag contact and the chain discovery provide the final two moments. Place text-4 with Bori's contact and directed attention, and reserve text-5 for the chain discovery, spreading the explanatory lettering across the ending. Keep Doyun on eastern ground and the rescued boy behind him after his protective response. Lia remains close enough to assist Maren and reach the bag. The rock wall limits the deer's retreat; its antlers face the bridge entrance. Keep the right railing's displacement and the fallen rope readable without detailing an attachment mechanism. Distinguish the water below the bridge from the puddle beside the deer. Show the chain end submerged in that puddle once. Maintain the rainy gorge setting, small turquoise shield magic within Lia's reach, and consistent clothing and props wherever finished references are available to the artist. Lia is an adult woman with dark chestnut hair, amber eyes, and faint nose freckles. Doyun is an adult man with black hair, gray eyes, and a small break in his left eyebrow. Maren is an adult woman with dark auburn curls, brown eyes, and a round face. The boy remains a child. Bori is a cute, small quadrupedal marten with round ears, short forepaws, cream fur, and a long tail tipped dark brown. Letter only the five selected verbatim Korean captions inside the image. Preserve third-person limited narration without adding private thoughts or future knowledge. End with Maren's escape unfinished and Bori's ability still only a disclosed possibility.

beats.action: Following the opening direction, the boy steps onto the trembling light. Lia accompanies him sideways with her arm raised, and Doyun pulls him up from eastern ground. Select the upward handover as the visible culmination of this continuous crossing.
The boy settles onto a rock with both feet grounded. Lia sees that he has reached safety and takes a breath. Let his settled position and her release of tension share one quiet instant.

Maren stands as the ironwork bundle rolls beneath the empty cargo compartment. Show the rolling bundle while she is upright; her movement coincides with the disturbance without establishing how it began.

The wagon turns sideways, pulls the right railing, and leaves a broken railing rope at the deer's feet. Select the turned wagon, displaced railing, and newly fallen rope as the visible consequence of the preceding disturbance.

The deer retreats until the rock wall prevents further backward movement, then turns its broad antlers toward the bridge entrance. Show the resulting orientation, with the wall making the restricted retreat understandable.

Doyun moves the boy behind himself and lowers his sword tip. His completed protective position can coexist with the deer's completed turn, allowing the danger and his response to remain readable in one stable moment.

Lia grips Maren's arm while two steps remain. A plank drops into the water during the unfinished escape. Retain Lia's grip and the newly lost plank as the continuing conditions for Bori's interruption.
Bori cries sharply from inside the still-closed bag. Show this interruption while Lia holds Maren and the fallen plank is already in the water below.

Lia opens the bag. Bori's forepaw meets the back of her hand, with small golden sparks among puffed fur. Select the contact after the flap has been raised, keeping Bori's attention directed toward the chain.

Bori's attention reveals the slack chain beside the deer as the relevant detail. Its end becomes exposed as the deer shifts its feet, but depict only the submerged phase. Disclose Bori's electrical sensitivity and then the strict limit of the available lightning, ending before any attempt to use it.

facts.statement: An unidentified speaker directs movement onto the left light. The boy steps onto the shield, which trembles beneath his shoe. Lia moves sideways with him without lowering her arm. Doyun reaches from eastern ground and pulls him up.
The boy sits down on a rock with both feet on the ground. Seeing this lets Lia take a breath.
As Maren stands, a bundle of heavy ironwork rolls beneath the empty cargo compartment. The wagon turns sideways and pulls the right railing. A broken railing rope falls at the deer's feet.
The deer backs away, cannot retreat farther because of a rock wall, and turns until its broad antlers face the bridge entrance. Doyun pushes the boy behind himself and lowers his sword tip.
Lia grips Maren's arm with two steps still remaining. During this interval, a plank falls into the water.
Bori cries sharply inside the bag. Lia raises its flap; a small forepaw touches the back of her hand, and golden sparks jump among Bori's puffed fur.
Bori watches the slack chain beside the deer. Its end alternates between being submerged in a puddle and becoming exposed as the deer moves its feet.
Bori recognizes places electricity can flow before humans do. Bori can produce only a short, nearby sting of lightning and lacks the power to bring down the deer.

The boy sits on a rock with both feet on eastern ground; Lia, with dark chestnut hair and amber eyes, watches with eased shoulders.
Maren, with dark auburn curls, stands upright; a heavy ironwork bundle is rolling beneath the wagon's empty cargo compartment.
The wagon is turned sideways, the right railing pulled askew; a broken railing rope lies at the deer's feet.
The rock wall is behind the deer, whose broad antlers face the bridge entrance; on eastern ground, Doyun stands protectively before the boy, sword tip lowered.
Lia grips Maren's arm, their escape unfinished; the fallen plank is in the water below the bridge. Bori cries inside the closed bag.
Bori's forepaw rests on the back of Lia's free hand beside the raised bag flap; golden sparks fleck its puffed cream fur, its gaze directed toward the chain.
Beside the deer's feet, the slack chain's end is submerged in a puddle.

units.text: 리아는 왼손을 마렌의 발 앞에 내리고 오른손을 보리 곁으로 들었다.
“도윤, 왼쪽으로 비켜.”
그가 소년과 함께 바위 쪽으로 물러났다.
보리가 리아의 팔을 타고 한 뼘 올라왔다. 가방을 떠난 뒷발이 팔꿈치를 꽉 움켜쥐었다. 리아는 손바닥의 방패를 사슴 옆 쇠사슬 쪽으로 비스듬히 틀었다.
금빛이 터졌다.
짧은 번개가 청록색 면을 긁으며 꺾였다. 방패 가장자리가 밝게 번지고, 그 뒤를 따라간 빛이 쇠사슬 고리 사이에서 꽃처럼 갈라졌다. 탁, 하는 소리가 바위벽에 부딪혀 돌아왔다.
사슴의 뿔이 옆으로 돌아갔다.
그것으로 충분했다.
“지금!”
마렌이 왼손 방패를 밟았다. 리아는 무게를 정면으로 떠받치는 대신 발끝이 땅 쪽으로 미끄러지도록 빛의 면을 낮췄다. 마렌의 몸이 앞으로 기울었다. 도윤이 팔을 잡아당겼다.
방패가 부서졌다.
청록빛 조각이 리아의 무릎 주위로 흩어졌다. 마렌은 바위턱에 엎어졌고 리아는 한쪽 발이 빠졌다. 마차를 묶었던 마지막 줄이 발목을 감아 왼쪽으로 끌고 갔다.
그제야 자신이 돌아갈 자리를 보았다.
없었다.

plan.intent: Make Maren's rescue feel earned through coordinated, limited actions, then turn that success into immediate danger for Lia. The lightning creates a brief opportunity; Lia's controlled lowering and Doyun's pull complete the transfer. End with Lia realizing too late that she has left herself no place to return.
plan.staging: Use seven generous panels for one continuous, finished full-color fantasy comic with expressive ink lines and a natural vertical reading flow. The artist chooses compositions, proportions, and viewpoints; the nine beats are events, not panel assignments. Combine compatible preparation and consequences where their order stays clear, while allowing the final recognition a distinct pause. Maintain the rainy gorge and damaged bridge context. Lia must remain within reach of Maren's feet, Bori, and her small shields; Doyun must be positioned to pull Maren onto the rock ledge after moving with the boy toward the rocks. Keep the boy out of the transfer path. Distinguish the left-hand foothold from the surface angled toward the chain beside the deer. Preserve the short bolt's visible redirection, the branching light between links, and the subsequent antler turn without adding electrical mechanisms. The lowered foothold guides Maren downward and forward; it does not launch her. Keep turquoise fragments near Lia's knees, Maren prone on the ledge, and the rope around Lia's ankle pulling left. Maintain that relative direction without assigning it a compass bearing. If the wagon appears, preserve the supplied textual continuity of its perilous bridge position. Lia is an adult woman with dark chestnut hair, amber eyes, and faint nose freckles; Doyun is an adult man with black hair, gray eyes, and a small break in his left eyebrow; Maren is an adult woman with dark auburn curls, brown eyes, and a round face. The boy remains a child. Bori is a small quadrupedal marten with round ears, short forepaws, cream fur, and a long dark-tipped tail. Follow available finished references for clothing and props. Keep at most two small light shields within Lia's reach, with no amplification or stored-power effect. Letter only the five selected Korean captions inside the image, exactly as supplied, with text-4 before text-5. Preserve Lia's limited perspective and stop before any subsequent rescue or fall.

Ch-1-p-62 does not explicitly name which shield breaks. Its placement during the transfer supports the foothold reading, but does not establish that both shields shatter or explain the precise failure mechanism.

beats.action: Lia positions her hands for the rescue: left low before Maren's feet, right beside Bori. Following the instruction to move left, Doyun retreats toward the rocks with the boy, making the changed positions readable before the magic is used.

Bori leaves the bag and climbs a handspan along Lia's arm, anchoring its hind feet at her elbow. Lia angles the palm-held shield toward the chain beside the deer. Their small, deliberate movements establish the preparation for the flash.

Golden light bursts into a short bolt that scrapes and bends along the turquoise shield. Its edge brightens before the redirected light branches between the chain links. The sharp report echoes against the rock wall.
The antlers turn sideways, giving the rescuers the opportunity they need. Preserve the urgency of the unattributed action cue through the immediate transition into Maren's movement.

Maren steps onto the left-hand shield. Lia lowers the surface so Maren's toes slide toward the ground; Maren tips forward, and Doyun pulls her arm. Make the lowering and the human pull legible as the actions that carry her toward the ledge.
The shield breaks after Doyun's pull has begun. Turquoise fragments scatter around Lia's knees, abruptly ending the support during the transfer.
Maren lands prone on the rock ledge as Lia loses her footing on one side. Let Maren's concrete arrival register alongside Lia's sudden instability.
The last wagon-securing rope catches around Lia's ankle and draws her left. Her danger continues after Maren has reached the ledge.
Lia finally looks for her own return foothold and discovers there is none. End at this recognition, with the rope's pull unresolved.

facts.statement: Lia lowers her left hand in front of Maren's feet and raises her right hand beside Bori. A command directs Doyun to move left. He retreats toward the rocks with the boy.
Bori climbs a handspan along Lia's arm, leaving the bag and gripping her elbow tightly with its hind feet. Lia angles a palm-held shield toward the chain beside the deer.

Golden light bursts. A short lightning bolt scrapes the turquoise surface and changes direction. The shield's edge brightens, and the following light branches like a flower between the chain links. A sharp sound echoes from the rock wall.
The deer's antlers turn sideways. This is sufficient for the rescue attempt to proceed, and an immediate action cue follows.
Maren steps on the left-hand shield. Lia lowers its light surface so Maren's toes slide toward the ground instead of taking the weight directly. Maren tilts forward, and Doyun pulls her arm.
A shield breaks, scattering turquoise fragments around Lia's knees. Maren falls prone onto a rock ledge, while Lia loses her footing on one side.
The last rope that had secured the wagon wraps around Lia's ankle and drags her left.
Only then does Lia look for a place to return to. There is none.

units.text: “줄 잡아!”
도윤이 던진 매듭이 어깨를 때렸다. 리아는 오른손을 뻗었다. 저린 손가락이 한 번 미끄러졌다. 가방으로 돌아가려던 보리가 팔에서 미끄러지자 왼팔로 끌어안았다.
마차가 내려앉았다.
리아는 매듭을 팔꿈치까지 감고 눈을 감지 않았다. 도윤의 칼이 발목 가까이 번쩍였다. 팽팽하던 결박이 끊어지는 순간 몸이 위로 당겨졌다.
배가 바위 모서리에 부딪혔다. 아팠다. 그 아픔이 반가웠다.
도윤이 줄을 잡아끌었고, 마렌도 엎드린 채 리아의 재킷을 붙잡았다. 발끝이 허공을 빠져나왔다. 뒤에서 다리 한쪽이 길게 찢어졌다. 남은 마차가 비스듬한 들보에 걸리며 멎었다. 굵은 쇳소리가 계곡 아래로 울렸다.
리아는 젖은 땅에 뺨을 대고 숨을 몰아쉬었다.
가슴 아래에서 보리가 발버둥쳤다. 팔을 풀자 보리는 곧장 가방에 들어갔다. 덮개 밖으로 코만 내밀더니 리아를 보며 재채기했다.
“알았어. 다음엔 마른 데.”
목소리가 떨려 끝까지 웃지는 못했다.
도윤이 소년, 마렌, 리아를 차례로 보았다. 마지막에는 바위 뒤에 묶인 말까지 확인했다.
“다 있어요.”

plan.intent: Turn Lia's failed grip into a rescue sustained by deliberate human actions: she protects Bori, Doyun frees and pulls her, and Maren helps bring her onto ground. Let the bridge's continuing failure establish how narrowly they escape. Release the tension through Bori's retreat into the bag and Lia's shaky humor, then close on Doyun checking that everyone is present.
plan.staging: Use eight clearly legible panels for one continuous, finished full-color fantasy scene with expressive ink lines and a natural vertical reading flow. The eleven beats describe events, not panel assignments; combine compatible events while preserving their internal order. Leave panel proportions and viewpoints to the artist. Maintain the rainy gorge, damaged bridge, and nearby rock landing. Distinguish Doyun's rescue rope from the binding near Lia's ankle: the binding is cut while the rescue rope remains available for hauling. Doyun's blade must be within physical reach of the binding; Maren remains prone while reaching Lia's jacket. Lia's abdomen contacts the rock before her feet clear the drop. Keep the endangered wagon in the bridge structure, then caught on the inclined beam, separate from the ground where the people recover. The bridge tears after Lia's extraction; the wagon stops on the beam rather than falling to the gorge floor. Maintain Bori's continuity from Lia's protective left arm to beneath her chest, then into the accessible bag after she releases it. Preserve the horse tied behind a rock for Doyun's final check. Lia is an adult woman with dark chestnut hair, amber eyes, and faint nose freckles; Doyun is an adult man with black hair, gray eyes, and a small break in his left eyebrow; Maren is an adult woman in her forties with dark auburn curls, brown eyes, and a round face. The boy remains a child. Bori is a small cream-furred quadrupedal marten with round ears, short forepaws, and a long tail with a dark brown tip. Follow accessible finished references for clothing and props. Keep the recovery physically exhausted, with only a brief, incomplete smile from Lia. Letter only the five selected text entries, verbatim, inside the image. Convey the remaining narration through action, including the sneeze, without invented sound-effect lettering. Retain Lia's limited perspective and introduce no new magic.

“밀가루 여섯…….”

리아가 몸을 일으키려 하자 오른손목에 통증이 몰렸다. 도윤이 팔을 내밀었다.

“그러면 왼손 줘.”
그는 기다렸다. 리아는 왼손을 내밀었다.
바위뿔사슴은 조금 떨어진 길목에서 계곡 아래를 보고 있었다. 사람을 향해 뿔을 들었던 몸이 이제는 아래쪽 비탈을 향해 기울었다. 한 발 내려가던 사슴이 멈췄다가 다시 올라왔다. 리아가 고개를 갸웃하는 사이, 그것은 굽을 구르며 바위 뒤로 물러났다.
“쫓아간 건 아닌데 물러났네.”
도윤이 칼을 닦으며 말했다.

units.text: 리아는 대답하려다 시선을 멈췄다.
그가 줄을 감았던 바위 안쪽에 작은 화살표가 새겨져 있었다. 끝이 두 갈래로 갈라지고, 아래에는 손톱만 한 짧은 선이 하나 더 있었다.
리아는 가방의 안주머니를 열었다. 접힌 지도를 꺼내려다 젖은 손을 옷에 문질렀다. 어머니가 그려 준 마지막 지도. 계곡 다리 동쪽은 빈 종이였고, 여백에는 익숙한 글씨로 한 줄만 남아 있었다.
아직 못 간 길.
리아는 종이의 화살표와 바위의 것을 번갈아 보았다. 어머니는 표시를 새기고 나면 늘 밑에 작은 선을 더했다. 비에 윗부분이 닳아도 어느 쪽이 위인지 알아보라고.
바위의 선은 빗물에 검게 젖어 있었다.
“뭐 있어?”
도윤이 물었다.
리아는 지도를 접었다. 오른손이 아파 가장자리가 삐뚤어졌다.
“길 표식.”
누구의 것인지는 말하지 않았다.
화살표는 사슴이 내려가려다 돌아온 비탈을 가리키고 있었다.

This is the last map Lia's mother drew for her. The area east of the gorge bridge is blank, and the margin contains a single line in familiar handwriting about a path not yet traveled.

Lia looks back and forth between the arrow on the paper and the carved arrow. Her mother habitually added a small line beneath a carved mark so its upright orientation would remain identifiable if rain wore away its upper portion.
The short line on the rock is dark with rainwater.
Doyun asks whether Lia has found something.
Lia folds the map, leaving its edges crooked because her right hand hurts. She identifies the discovery as a trail marker but does not say whose it is.
The arrow points toward the slope where the deer had attempted to descend before returning.

scenes.title: 비 그친 야영지, 남은 것을 세다

units.text: 비는 새벽에 그쳤고, 야영지 바닥은 아직 발을 디딜 때마다 물이 배어 나왔다.
마렌이 천막 대신 쓴 기름 먹인 천을 걷었다. 그 아래 남은 것들을 하나씩 밖으로 옮기며 소리 내어 세었다.
“밀가루 세 자루. 약 상자 하나. 기름 두 통. 마른 식량은…….”
세다 말고 입을 다물었다. 그녀는 장갑 한 짝만 낀 손으로 자루 주둥이를 다시 묶었다. 다른 한 짝은 어제 소년의 맨발 밑에 깔아 준 뒤로 젖어 있었다.
“해 지기 전에는 출발해야 합니다. 동쪽 마을은 이번 달 약이 아직 안 들어갔어요.”
도윤은 어제 쓴 줄을 무릎에 펴 놓고 손가락으로 훑는 중이었다. 젖은 섬유가 손끝에 걸렸다. 그는 줄을 접어 놓고 고개를 들었다.
“리아. 오른손.”
리아는 소매를 손등까지 끌어내렸다.
“말은 살았고, 짐은 나눠서 지면 돼. 북쪽 비탈에 짐승길이 있어. 예전에 들은 길인데, 다리 없이도 건너편 능선으로 붙어.”
“누구한테 들었는데.”
도윤이 줄을 한 번 더 감았다. 감을 필요가 없는 줄이었다.
“퇴로부터 재고 올라가자. 못 돌아 나오는 길이면 짐이고 뭐고 없어.”

findings.en: Panel 2 draws Maren with gloves on both hands while p4 states she wears only one glove; panel 3 then correctly shows one gloved and one bare hand, so the glove state is inconsistent between panels 2 and 3.

findings.en: Panel 5 shows Doyun holding an already coiled rope in one hand rather than a rope spread across his knee being checked by fingertips (p6); the folded-away moment is implied, not shown.

findings.ko: 6칸: 리아가 오른손을 소매 안으로 숨기는 동작(p8)이 불분명.
findings.en: Panel 6 does not clearly show Lia's right hand pulled inside a dragged-down sleeve (p8); her non-pointing hand rests at her hip in a dark glove, so the hiding gesture is only weakly conveyed.

findings.ko: 1·5칸: 비 그친 뒤(p1)인데 가는 빗줄기 흔적 남음.
findings.en: Fine diagonal rain-like streaks remain visible in panels 1 and 5 although p1 states the rain stopped at dawn; the soaked ground itself is correct.

plan.intent: A quiet, tense morning-after inventory that turns into a route argument. The reader should feel the cost already paid (wet ground, ruined supplies, a glove given away) before anyone argues about the next road, then watch two kinds of care collide: Maren's deadline for medicine, Ria's confident shortcut she will not source, and Doyun's refusal to move until the way back is measured. Nothing is resolved by warmth or a joke; the scene ends on a condition, not a reassurance.
plan.staging: One continuous location: an open camp on soaked ground the morning after rain. Confirmed spatial facts only: the oiled cloth served as the shelter and is pulled back by Maren, with the surviving goods underneath it being moved out into the open near her; Maren handles a sack mouth and wears a glove on one hand only, the other bare; Doyun is seated with the rope laid across his knee, low enough that he must raise his head to address Ria; Ria is within easy speaking distance of Doyun and has a right hand she keeps covered by her sleeve. The north slope and its beast trail are spoken about, not entered — any view of terrain is background from the camp. Bori is present as the party's small marten companion; wet cold and loud weather are the conditions it avoids, so its placement is the artist's choice. Camera, panel shapes, distances and blocking are entirely the artist's call; the only requirement is that the reader can register the single glove, the snagging rope and the hidden right hand.
uncertainties: The source never names the speaker of the route proposal in ch-2-p-9; it is attributed here to Ria because Doyun's reply in ch-2-p-10 uses the familiar register he uses with her and she is the one evading his question. Treat the attribution as an inference, not a stated fact.
The source never says what is wrong with Ria's right hand, or whether anything is wrong at all. Do not draw a visible wound, bandage or magic burn; only the sleeve being pulled down is confirmed.
The identity of the barefoot boy from yesterday and his fate are unstated. Do not depict or imply him beyond the wet glove.
Why Maren's count stops at the dry food is unstated — whether the dry food is spoiled, gone, or merely uncounted. Do not resolve it visually.
The exact remaining quantity and condition of goods beyond the counted items is unstated.
The location, distance, visibility and current safety of the north-slope beast trail are unconfirmed; only that someone once heard it links to the opposite ridge without a bridge.
Whether the horse is in view, and its condition beyond being alive, is unstated.
Bori is not mentioned in this source excerpt at all; any presence is optional staging and must not alter events.

beats.action: Morning after the storm settles over the camp: rain ended, light is thin, the ground releases water wherever weight lands.
Maren strips back the oiled cloth shelter and starts hauling the surviving goods into the open, counting each item out loud for the others to hear.
The count dies at the dry food. She shuts her mouth and re-ties the sack mouth with her single gloved hand; the bare hand is the one whose glove went under a boy's feet yesterday and is still soaked.
Rather than name what is missing, Maren converts the loss into a deadline and presses for departure before sunset, citing the eastern village's undelivered medicine.

Doyun, checking the rain-soaked rope over his knee, feels the fibers snag, folds it away and asks Ria for her right hand. She answers by pulling her sleeve down over it, hiding rather than refusing out loud.
Ria overrides the question about her hand with a plan: horse alive, loads divided among them, a beast trail on the north slope that reaches the far ridge without any bridge.
Doyun does not challenge the route itself; he asks for its source. Ria gives a time instead of a name, and the gap in her answer is left standing.

His hands coil the rope again with no need for it, then he accepts the climb only on a condition: measure the exit first, because a road with no way back makes the cargo meaningless. The scene ends on that condition, unanswered.

facts.statement: The rain stopped at dawn; the camp ground is still waterlogged and seeps water under each footstep.
Maren used an oiled cloth instead of a tent; she pulls it back and carries the remaining goods out one by one, counting aloud.
Her count reaches three sacks of flour, one medicine box, two cans of oil, then the dry food, where she stops speaking.
Maren wears only one glove and re-ties a sack mouth with that hand; the other glove has been wet since she laid it under a boy's bare feet the day before.
Maren states they must depart before sunset because this month's medicine has not yet reached the eastern village.
Doyun has yesterday's rope spread across his knee and runs his fingers along it; the soaked fibers snag on his fingertips. He folds the rope and raises his head.
Doyun asks for Ria's right hand; instead of showing it she drags her sleeve down over the back of that hand.

The proposed route: the horse survived, the loads can be split and carried, and a beast trail on the north slope reaches the opposite ridge without needing a bridge. The speaker says it is a path heard about before.
Doyun asks who told her about it; the answer names no person, only a time long ago.
Doyun coils the rope one more time although the rope did not need coiling.
Doyun's condition: measure the way back out first before climbing; if it is a road they cannot come back out of, the cargo does not matter.

brief.style: Finished full-color fantasy comic, expressive ink linework, muted rain-washed morning palette, adult cast, small marten optional in background, vertical reading order, Korean lettering drawn in-panel.

moments.action: Wet mountain camp under thin post-rain dawn light; a boot presses the soaked ground and water seeps up around the sole.

Close on Maren's hands, one gloved and one bare, pulling a sack mouth knot tight; her lips are pressed shut, counting stopped.

Doyun seated low, damp rope folded across his knee under one hand, head lifted toward Ria as he speaks.
Ria stands talking, her right hand swallowed inside a dragged-down sleeve, her other hand tipped toward the wooded slope behind camp.
Two faces close together: Doyun holding a level look at Ria, Ria's eyes angled away, her covered hand still at her side.
Doyun's hands wind one more loop onto the already-neat coil while he speaks; Ria unanswered at the frame edge.

units.text: 말은 오래된 짐승길이 싫은 모양이었다. 비탈 아래쪽 자갈이 무너지는 소리에 귀를 눕히고 버텼다. 셋은 결국 짐을 나눠 졌다. 리아는 약 상자를 가슴에 안았고, 도윤은 밀가루 두 자루, 마렌은 나머지와 기름통을 등짐 끈에 묶었다.
말고삐는 도윤이 잡고 앞장섰다. 리아는 약 상자를 안은 팔에 힘을 주다가 오른손목이 저려 상자를 왼팔로 옮겼다. 두 걸음마다 상자 모서리가 갈비뼈를 눌렀다.
마렌은 맨 뒤에서 걸었다. 숨소리가 굽이마다 짧아졌지만 걸음은 줄지 않았다. 리아가 돌아볼 때마다 마렌은 턱을 들어 먼저 가라는 시늉을 했다.
기름통은 세 번째 굽이에서 갔다.
젖은 바위 위로 마렌의 발이 미끄러지자 등에서 끈이 돌았고, 둥근 통이 어깨를 넘어 비탈로 떨어졌다. 두 번 튀고, 세 번째에 바위 모서리에 부딪혀 터졌다. 기름 냄새가 아래에서 올라왔다.
마렌은 한참 그 자리를 보았다.
턱이 흔들렸다. 마렌은 말을 끝내지 않고 남은 자루를 고쳐 멨다.

plan.intent: A load-sharing march that quietly shows what each person chooses to carry, then takes one thing away. The reader should first feel weight distributed by character — the medicine pressed to a chest, flour on a swordsman's back, everything left over roped onto the oldest person — then feel the slow grind of it: a numb wrist, a box corner against ribs, breath shortening at every bend while the pace refuses to drop. The loss, when it comes, is not an attack or a monster; it is wet rock and a turned strap. End on Maren counting out loud and failing to finish the count, then re-shouldering what is left. No comfort, no joke, no one says it is fine.
plan.staging: One continuous location: an old, narrow beast trail climbing a mountain slope on the morning after rain — same weather and light continuity as the previous finished scene, wet rock and soaked ground, no active rainfall. Confirmed spatial relations only: the trail runs along a slope with a drop on one side, and loose gravel below that drop makes noise; marching order is Doyun at the front with the reins, Ria in the middle, Maren last; the trail has bends, and the loss happens at the third one. Load placement is fixed: medicine box held against Ria's chest, later shifted to her left arm; two flour sacks on Doyun; the remaining goods and the oil can tied to Maren's back-carry straps, high enough that a twisted strap sends the can over her shoulder. The can's fall path is down the slope away from the walkers: two bounces, then it bursts on a rock edge below, and the smell comes upward. Ria can turn her head and see Maren behind her. Bori travels with Ria and the pack as usual; wet cold is what it avoids, so its exact position is the artist's choice and must not change any event. Camera, panel shapes, distances and cutting are entirely the artist's call; the only requirements are that the reader can register who carries what, the arm-change with the box, Maren's rearmost position, and the can leaving her shoulder.
uncertainties: The previous scene counted two cans of oil, while this excerpt speaks of a single can going over the slope and Maren then saying a one-can count. Whether a second can survives on her back is not stated. Do not visually confirm or deny a second can.
Why Ria's right wrist goes numb is not stated in the source — no wound, bandage, or magic effect is described. Do not draw any injury; only the grip failing and the box changing arms is confirmed.
Whether Doyun or Ria reacts to the fall, looks back, or speaks is not stated. The source gives no line from them here. Do not invent dialogue or a rescue attempt.
What Maren was going to say after the unfinished count is unstated. Leave it unresolved.
The precise cause of Maren's shortening breath (age, load weight, altitude, injury) is unstated.
The horse's position after the loads are split — whether it is led up the same trail, how close it is at the third bend — is not stated beyond Doyun holding the reins at the front.
The exact height of the drop, the depth the can falls, and whether the burst point is visible from the trail are unstated.
Bori is not mentioned in this excerpt; any appearance is optional staging only.

beats.action: On the old beast trail the horse balks: gravel slides loose below the slope, its ears go flat, and it braces against the pull instead of walking.

The party gives up on the horse carrying it and splits the cargo across three bodies — medicine box into Ria's arms against her chest, two flour sacks onto Doyun, and all the leftovers with the oil can roped to Maren's carrying straps. The oldest person ends up with the remainder.
The line forms: Doyun takes the reins at the front, Ria behind him, Maren at the tail.
Ria's right wrist gives out under the squeeze and she moves the box to her left arm — hiding the failure by changing arms instead of naming it. The box corner keeps knocking her ribs as she walks.

At the rear Maren's breath keeps shortening bend by bend while her stride stays the same, and every time Ria turns to check, Maren lifts her chin to send her forward — refusing to be the reason anyone slows.

At the third bend the wet rock takes Maren's foot, the strap twists on her back, and the round can rides over her shoulder onto the slope: two bounces, then the rock edge, then it splits open. Oil smell comes back up at them.
Maren does not move for a long moment, looking down at the burst point, and starts counting the loss out loud.

Her jaw shakes and the count stops unfinished; she cuts herself off and re-shoulders the sack still on her back, turning the loss into work instead of words. The others are left holding what they carry.

facts.statement: The horse dislikes the old beast trail: at the sound of gravel collapsing below the slope it flattens its ears and plants itself, refusing to move.
Because of the horse, the three of them split the cargo onto their own bodies.
Division of load: Ria holds the medicine box against her chest; Doyun takes two sacks of flour; Maren ties everything remaining plus the oil can onto her back-carry straps.
Doyun holds the horse's reins and walks at the front of the line.
Ria tightens her grip on the box, her right wrist goes numb, and she shifts the box over to her left arm. Every two steps the corner of the box presses into her ribs.
Maren walks last. Her breathing grows shorter at each bend of the trail, but her stride does not shorten.
Each time Ria looks back, Maren lifts her chin in a gesture telling her to go on ahead.

plan.intent: A quiet aftermath scene about how three people convert a loss into information. The reader should feel Maren refusing consolation by pricing the loss as her own, then watch Doyun go down and come back holding almost nothing — one iron hoop, the only thing worth carrying up. The turn lands when Maren explains she never wanted the oil back: she wanted to know how far it rolled, because someone lighting a fire below needs warning. That reframes the whole loss from private ruin into a hazard report, and it is Maren, the hired carter, not the guides, who thinks of it. Close small and physical: her hands pulling the pack straps tighter than before, Ria silently registering two extra turns in the knot, and Bori refusing to give up the dry pocket of the bag even after the oil smell makes it sneeze. No reassurance, no thanks, no joke.
plan.staging: Continuous with the previous finished scene and immediately after it: the same narrow old beast trail on a rain-soaked mountain slope, morning after rain, wet rock, no active rainfall, same light. The party stands at the third bend where Maren slipped. Confirmed spatial relations only: the slope drops away on one side of the trail; the burst can lies somewhere below, out of easy reach, and the oil smell rises from down there. Doyun's movement is short and bounded — a few steps down, then back up to the trail; he ends up standing on the trail again holding one iron hoop. Marching order from before still holds as the default arrangement (Doyun forward, Ria middle, Maren rearmost), but the group is halted here, so exact footing positions are the artist's choice. Maren's load is on her back with carrying straps and a knot at a place she can reach and re-tighten herself; Ria is close enough to see that knot. Ria still carries the medicine box (in her left arm, per the previous scene) and the bag with Bori; Bori's nose can clear the bag flap, and the bag opening must be reachable from inside. The oil smell is present in the air at trail level. Whether the burst can itself is visible from where they stand is not established — do not force a clear view of it. Panel shapes, cameras, distances and cutting are entirely the artist's call; the only required legibility is: Maren refusing comfort, Doyun returning with a single hoop and nothing else, Maren speaking while the others hold still, her hands on the tightened straps, and Bori's nose-out-sneeze-back-in.
uncertainties: ch-2-p-25 uses wording implying Maren 'sent' Doyun down, but no such request is shown in the source. Do not stage an explicit order or dialogue for it; the assignment's origin stays ambiguous.
Who, if anyone, offered Maren comfort before ch-2-p-22 is not stated. Do not invent a consoling line from Ria or Doyun.
Ria's and Doyun's reactions to Maren's reasoning are unstated — no reply, agreement, or thanks is given in the source. Leave them unspoken.
Whether they actually know of anyone camped below, or will act on the warning, is unstated. It stays a stated obligation, not a confirmed presence.
How far the can rolled and whether the burst point is visible from the trail remain unstated.
The state of the remaining load on Maren's back (including whether a second oil can survives, which the previous scene left open) is unstated. Do not visually confirm or deny a second can.
Why Maren adds two extra turns to the knot is not explained in the source. Show only the tighter knot and Ria noticing it; do not caption a motive.

plan.intent: A scene about a guide refusing to spend the group's strength before the road is confirmed. The reader should first feel the cost of the halt — sunrise only half over the ridge, a loaded climb already underway, and Ria calling a stop before the cargo goes up. Maren's disbelief prices that stop honestly: stopping mid-climb wastes what they already spent. Ria's answer is the scene's spine — being wrong means losing twice, so the route gets checked before the weight follows. Then the payoff is silent and physical: Ria goes up alone, and the wet ground gives her more than she asked for. Not one turn but three, layered in the same spot, grass flattened sideways and soil dug out in the middle. The reader should arrive at the reading a beat before or with Ria: this is not an animal fleeing something behind it. This is an animal that tried to go down and was stopped, over and over, at exactly this place. End on that recognition, not on a plan.
plan.staging: Morning after rain, continuous in weather and light with the previous finished scene: wet rock and wet soil, no active rainfall, ground still soaked enough to hold impressions. The party is partway up a slope on the old beast trail; the sun sits half above the ridgeline, so light is low and raking from the ridge direction, which also means ground marks read with long shadows. Confirmed spatial facts only: (1) the group halts mid-ascent, below the spot Ria wants to inspect; (2) the inspection spot is higher up the slope from where the group stops, close enough that Ria reaches it on foot and alone; (3) that spot is the same place where a deer began to descend the day before and came back out; (4) the medicine box Ria has been carrying is set down on the ground before she climbs; (5) the load spoken of in ch-2-p-29 stays where the group halted, not carried up. On the ground at the inspection point, the arrangement of evidence is fixed and must stay legible: downward and upward hoof prints overlapping in one place, three layers of turning marks at that same place, grass around the outside pressed flat sideways, soil in the middle scooped and torn. Whether the blocked route below is visible from Ria's position is not established — do not show what stopped the deer. Which other companions are present at the halt beyond Maren is not stated by these units; if a wider party is shown for continuity, keep them at the halt point and do not give them lines. Panel shapes, camera distances, cutting and reading rhythm are entirely the artist's choice; required legibility is only: the halt, Maren's widened eyes, Ria speaking her reason, Ria alone at the tracks, and the ground evidence readable enough that the three overlapping turns are countable.
uncertainties: ch-2-p-28 through ch-2-p-35 never mention c2 or c3. Whether Doyun and Bori are present at this halt is unstated — do not give them dialogue, reactions or a decisive action.
The nature of the load in ch-2-p-29 (whose cargo, how it is carried, whether on an animal or on backs) is unstated in these units. Do not visually settle it.
What blocked the deer from descending is never stated. Show no cause, no creature, no barrier — only the turning marks.
Whether Ria actually witnessed the deer yesterday or is reconstructing it from earlier observation is ambiguous in ch-2-p-33. Avoid staging an explicit flashback as confirmed memory.
Maren's line in ch-2-p-31 is a question, not a refusal. Whether she accepts or resists the halt is unstated; leave her compliance unresolved.
No reply from anyone follows Ria's reason in ch-2-p-32. Do not add agreement or thanks.
The exact vertical distance between the halt point and the track site is unstated.
Whether Ria voices her conclusion aloud is unstated — ch-2-p-35 is narration only. Keep the reading internal.
Whether these tracks relate to the mother's markings or to any earlier discovery is not stated in these units; do not imply a connection.

units.text: 리아는 자국을 따라 바위틈 앞까지 갔다. 사람 어깨가 겨우 지날 좁은 통로였다. 젖은 낙엽이 입구를 덮고 있었다.
통로 안쪽에서 찬 바람이 나왔다. 젖은 흙 냄새가 아니라 마른 돌 냄새였다. 리아는 한 발을 들여놓다가 멈췄다. 발밑 낙엽이 평평했다. 비탈에 저절로 쌓인 낙엽은 평평하지 않다.
가방이 흔들렸다.
덮개를 밀고 나온 보리의 털이 등줄기를 따라 부풀었다. 리아가 낙엽 쪽으로 손을 뻗자 보리의 작은 앞발이 손등을 밀쳤다.
“키익!”
“알았어. 안 만져.”
보리는 코로 낙엽 더미를 가리키고는 리아의 어깨 위로 올라가 꼬리를 리아의 목에 감았다.
리아는 나뭇가지로 낙엽을 걷어 냈다.

plan.intent: A scene where a guide's own careful reading of the ground is overruled by something smaller than her hand. The reader should first feel the narrowing: the tracks end at a split in the rock only wide enough for one set of shoulders, its mouth smothered in soaked leaves. Then the wrongness arrives through the body before the mind — cold air coming out, and the smell is dry stone, not the wet earth everything else smells like this morning. Ria puts one foot in and stops, and the reason is small and precise: the leaves underfoot are flat, and leaves that pile up on a slope by themselves are never flat. The reader should reach that conclusion with her. Then the bag moves. Bori, who wants nothing more than to stay dry and hidden, comes out anyway with its spine fur standing, and physically shoves her reaching hand away. The payoff is not an explanation — Bori cannot give one. It points with its nose at the leaf pile, then climbs to her shoulder and wraps its tail around her neck, which is what it does when it is frightened. Ria concedes with two short words and does not touch the leaves with her hand. She uses a branch instead. End on the branch moving the leaves, not on what is found.
plan.staging: Morning after rain on the old beast trail, continuous with the previous finished scene: no active rainfall, wet rock, soaked ground and soaked leaf litter, low raking light. Confirmed spatial facts, all of which must stay legible: (1) the tracks Ria has been following lead her on foot to a gap between rocks; (2) the gap is a passage so narrow a person's shoulders only just fit, so it must read as a single-body slot, not a cave mouth; (3) wet fallen leaves lie over the entrance; (4) air flows outward from inside the passage toward Ria, and it is cold; (5) Ria gets one foot inside the entrance, and stops there with her weight divided between inside and outside; (6) the leaf bed under that foot is flat — its flatness on a sloping hillside is the visual evidence and must be readable against the uneven natural litter elsewhere on the slope; (7) Bori is inside the bag Ria carries, as established previously, and comes out through the flap itself — no one hands it out and it is not riding on anyone else; (8) Bori's raised fur runs along the spine, and its forepaws are short; (9) Bori's paw contacts the back of Ria's hand and pushes it away from the leaves; (10) after the cry and Ria's reply, Bori's nose points at the leaf pile, then Bori relocates onto Ria's shoulder with its tail around her neck; (11) the final action uses a tree branch, not her hand, to sweep the leaves off. What lies beneath the leaves is not established by these units and must not be shown or implied. Panel shapes, camera distances, cutting and vertical reading rhythm are the artist's choice; prefer fewer, larger, clearly legible panels.
uncertainties: Units ch-2-p-36 through ch-2-p-43 never mention c2 or c4. Whether Doyun or Maren is nearby is unstated — give them no dialogue, no reaction and no decisive action, and do not stage them as witnesses to the concession.
What is underneath the flat leaves is never stated. Show nothing beneath them, no pit, no trap, no creature, no light, and do not let the branch reveal a result inside this scene.
Where the passage leads, how deep it is and whether anything is visible inside it are unstated. Keep the interior unresolved darkness rather than a rendered space.

Bori's ability to sense electric current exists in the foundation but these units never state that it is sensing electricity here. Do not draw sparks, arcs, glow or any discharge, and do not visually assert a cause for its alarm.
Whether Ria pulls her foot back out of the passage after stopping is unstated.
The source of the tracks Ria followed in ch-2-p-36 is not named in these units. Do not label or identify the animal.
Ria never speaks her reasoning about the flat leaves aloud; ch-2-p-37 is narration only. Keep that deduction internal.
Whether the cold air is a draft from a larger cavity or something else is not explained. Do not visually propose a mechanism.
No connection to the mother's markings or to any earlier discovery is stated in these units; do not imply one.
Ria's reply in ch-2-p-41 is a concession, not an understanding. Do not stage her as having grasped Bori's reason.

beats.action: Following the tracks brings Ria to a split in the rock, a passage barely wide enough for shoulders, its entrance blanketed in soaked leaves.
Cold air pushes out of the opening, and what it carries is the smell of dry stone, wrong for a morning where everything else is soaked.
Ria commits one foot into the gap and halts, because the leaf bed under her boot lies flat, and a slope never stacks leaves flat by itself.
The bag jolts; Bori forces the flap open and emerges with its spine fur bristling, abandoning the dry hiding place it never willingly leaves.
As Ria's hand goes out toward the leaves, Bori's forepaw knocks it back and it shrieks at her.
Ria yields immediately and withdraws the hand, conceding out loud without demanding a reason she knows Bori cannot give.
Bori aims its nose at the leaf pile once, then retreats up onto Ria's shoulder and coils its tail around her neck, the posture it takes when afraid.
Ria takes a branch and strips the leaves away with it, keeping her skin off whatever is underneath.

facts.statement: Ria follows the tracks until she arrives in front of a gap in the rock.
The passage is narrow enough that a person's shoulders barely pass through it.
Wet fallen leaves cover the mouth of the passage.
Cold air comes out from inside the passage.
The air smells of dry stone rather than wet soil.
Ria places one foot inside and then stops.
The leaves under her foot are flat, and leaves that accumulate on a slope on their own are not flat.
The bag moves, and Bori pushes the flap open and comes out with the fur along its spine standing up.
When Ria reaches a hand toward the leaves, Bori's small forepaw shoves the back of her hand away.
Bori cries out once, and Ria answers that she will not touch it.
Bori indicates the pile of leaves with its nose, then climbs onto Ria's shoulder and winds its tail around her neck.
Ria clears the leaves away using a tree branch instead of her hand.

brief.style: Finished full-color fantasy comic, expressive ink lines, adult cast plus a cute small marten. Morning after rain, wet rock and soaked leaf litter, low raking light.

moments.action: A wet rock split barely one shoulder wide, its mouth smothered in soaked leaves. Lia stands before it, hair and collar pushed back by cold air flowing outward.
Low angle: Lia's one boot planted inside the entrance on a flat leaf bed, her other foot outside on uneven litter. She halts, eyes down.
The flap of the bag Lia carries is shoved open from inside; the small marten Bori emerges, fur along its spine bristling, fixed on the leaves.
Bori's short forepaw shoves the back of Lia's outstretched hand away from the leaf pile, mouth open in a shriek.
Lia's hand pulled back near her chest, palm open, speaking quietly; Bori still braced at her chest, nose angled toward the leaf pile.
Bori now on Lia's shoulder, tail wound around her neck; Lia sweeps the flat leaves aside with a tree branch. Nothing visible beneath, passage interior dark.

units.text: 쇠사슬이었다.
굵은 고리가 통로를 가로질러 양쪽 바위에 박힌 쇠못에 걸려 있었다. 녹이 두껍게 앉았지만 못은 흔들리지 않았다. 사슬 가운데에 짙은 갈색 털 한 줌이 끼어 있었고, 그 위쪽 바위에는 뿔이 긁고 간 흰 자국이 여러 겹으로 나 있었다.
리아는 사슬에 낀 털을 손가락으로 빼냈다. 끝이 잘리지 않고 뽑혀 있었다. 사슴은 여기서 걸렸고, 걸린 채로 버티다 물러났다는 뜻이었다.
바위의 흰 자국은 높이가 제각각이었다. 어떤 것은 리아의 허리께에, 어떤 것은 무릎 아래에 있었다. 한 마리가 한 계절에 낸 자국이 아니었다.

findings.en: Panel 6 places several white scrapes at Lia's shoulder and head height in addition to waist and below-knee marks; the source names only waist-level and below-knee heights (p47).

findings.en: Panel 1 shows the left end of the chain running into leaves and rock without a clearly visible spike, so 'spikes on both walls' is only confirmed on the right side and in the panel 2 close-up.

findings.ko: 1칸은 사슬이 통로 중간 높이, 6칸은 무릎 높이. 같은 사슬로 안 읽힘.

plan.intent: The reveal under the leaves is not a monster but hardware: a chain, deliberately anchored. The reader should first take it in as an object — thick links strung across the one-body-wide passage, hooked on iron spikes driven into the rock on both sides — and only then register what it means, which arrives through small evidence Ria reads with her fingers. Rust lies thick but the spikes have not loosened, so this thing has been here long and still holds. A clump of dark brown hair is caught mid-chain, and the rock above it carries layered white gouges from antlers. When Ria pulls the hair free, the ends are torn out, not cut, and that single detail gives her the whole event: something was caught here, held on while caught, and backed off rather than broke through. The last turn is colder and larger than the one before it. She looks up and the white marks sit at wildly different heights, some at her waist, some below her knee. One animal in one season does not leave that. The scene should end on Ria's stillness in front of an old, repeatedly used thing, not on any answer about who put it there.
plan.staging: Immediately continuous with the previous finished scene: morning after rain on the old beast trail, no falling rain, wet rock and wet leaf litter, low raking light, same clothing and gear for Ria. Confirmed spatial facts that must stay legible: (1) the object revealed where the leaves were swept is a chain of thick links; (2) the chain runs across the passage from one side to the other, blocking it, and the passage remains the single-body-wide rock slot established earlier; (3) each end of the chain hangs on an iron spike driven into the rock on that side, so anchor points exist on both walls; (4) the chain and spikes are heavily rusted, yet the spikes sit firm in the stone; (5) a clump of dark brown hair is caught partway along the chain, near the middle of its span; (6) the white antler-scrape marks are on the rock above that clump, and they overlap in multiple layers rather than forming a single scratch; (7) Ria removes the hair with her fingers and holds it, and the hair's ends are ragged and torn rather than clean-cut; (8) the white marks occupy a range of heights measured against Ria's own standing body — some level with her waist, some lower than her knee — so her body needs to be readable as the scale reference when that range is shown. The interior of the passage beyond the chain stays unresolved darkness as before. Panel shapes, camera distances, cutting and vertical reading rhythm are the artist's choice; prefer fewer, larger, clearly legible panels.
uncertainties: These units never say who set the chain and spikes, when, or for what purpose. Do not add makers' marks, carvings, guild symbols, a marking connected to Ria's mother, or any other authorship clue.
The animal that left the hair and the antler scrapes is never shown or present in these units. Do not depict it, not even as a silhouette, reflection or memory inset.

Whether the chain is a trap, a barrier, a boundary marker or something else is not stated. Do not stage any mechanism, tension device, bell, snare loop or attached hardware beyond links and the two spikes.

ch-2-p-44 to ch-2-p-47 contain no dialogue and no other named character. Whether c2, c3 or c4 is nearby is unstated: give them no speech, no reaction and no decisive action, and do not have anyone else handle the chain or the hair.
Ria's conclusions in ch-2-p-46 and ch-2-p-47 are narration, not spoken lines. Keep the reasoning internal; do not convert captions into dialogue balloons.
How long the chain has been in place is not stated as a number. Rust and layered marks are the only evidence; do not date it with vegetation growth stages, bones or other invented time markers.
What lies on the far side of the chain, and whether the passage can be passed at all, is not established. Show no destination and no result of testing passage.
Whether Ria pulls, lifts or otherwise moves the chain beyond checking the spikes is not stated. Do not show her unhooking or breaking it.
Nothing in these units states any link to Bori's electrical sensing. Draw no sparks, arcs, glow or discharge on or near the metal.

beats.action: Under the swept leaves lies a chain: thick links crossing the narrow passage, caught on iron spikes set into the rock at either side.
The metal is heavily rusted, yet testing shows the spikes have not worked loose at all — the barrier still holds as it was meant to.
Mid-chain a tuft of dark brown hair is snagged, and the rock face above it carries layer upon layer of white antler scoring.
Ria works the hair free with her fingers and finds the ends torn, not severed.
The torn ends give her the sequence: a deer snagged here, held its ground while snagged, and finally backed away instead of breaking through.
She raises her eyes to the white marks and sees their heights scatter — some at her waist, some under her knee — which no single animal in one season could have made.

facts.statement: What the cleared leaves uncover is a chain.
Thick links run across the passage and hang on iron spikes driven into the rock on both sides.
Rust sits thick on the chain, but the spikes do not shift or wobble.
A clump of dark brown hair is caught in the middle of the chain.
On the rock above that clump, white marks scraped by antlers lie in several overlapping layers.
Ria pulls the trapped hair out of the chain with her fingers.
The ends of the hair are torn out rather than cut through.
From that, the meaning is that a deer was caught here, endured while caught, and then withdrew.
The white marks on the rock sit at differing heights, some around Ria's waist and some below her knee.
Marks spread across that range of heights are not what one animal in a single season would leave.

moments.action: Frontal view into the narrow wet rock slot: a thick rusted chain spans it wall to wall, each end hooked on an iron spike driven into the rock; darkness beyond.
Close on one anchor: the rusted spike sits flush and tight in the wet stone, a heavy link hanging from it, no gap or crumbling around the shaft.
Mid-span of the chain: a clump of dark brown hair snagged between links, and on the rock just above it, layered white antler scrapes crossing one another.
Ria's fingers draw the hair clump out from between the rusted links, her sleeve and gear unchanged from the morning trail.
Ria stands still, holding the freed tuft up between her fingers; the strand ends are ragged and torn rather than cleanly cut. The marten rides her shoulder, silent.
Wide shot: Ria upright beside the chained slot, facing the rock wall where white scrape marks sit at scattered heights, some level with her waist, some below her knee.

plan.intent: The chain stops being a puzzle about animals and becomes a question aimed at Ria. Doyun arrives from below with Maren behind him, and instead of looking down the dark slot he reads the hardware: he runs a finger over the spike head and finds the hammer-mashed metal, evidence of a tool and a hand. His conclusion is flat and physical, not accusatory. Then he stands and turns the same reading attention on his partner. beats.action: Footsteps climb up from below and the two of them arrive at the blocked slot, Doyun leading, Maren trailing him.
Doyun ignores the dark beyond the chain, crouches at the anchor point and reads the spike head with his fingertips, finding the struck surface crushed flat by a hammer.
He names what the tool marks mean - a person put this here, no animal caught itself - then rises and turns his attention from the metal to Ria.

He asks her how she knew this route, and her right wrist slides deeper into the sleeve before she has decided anything; she catches her own movement a beat late and realizes his eyes are already on that hand.
Ria answers with the deer instead - it wanted to descend, not attack, and kept coming back up because this point is sealed - offering true fieldwork in place of the thing he asked for.
Doyun refuses the substitution without raising his voice: he saw that as well, and it is not the question, leaving the real one standing between them.

facts.statement: Footsteps come up from below: Doyun first, Maren following behind him.
Doyun squats down in front of the chain and runs his fingers over the head of an iron spike.
The spot on the spike head that was struck by a hammer is mashed flat.
Doyun states the spikes were driven in by someone, and that this is not an animal getting snagged.
He stands up and looks at Ria.
Doyun asks Ria how she knew about this route.
Ria pushes her right wrist further up inside her sleeve.
She notices only afterwards that she made that movement, and also notices that Doyun's gaze is already on that hand.
Ria answers about the deer instead: it was not targeting people, it was trying to go downward, and because this point is blocked it came back up each time.
Doyun says he saw that too, and that it is not what he asked.

plan.intent: This is the scene where the obstacle stops being a mystery and becomes arithmetic that nobody likes. Maren, the freight hauler, is the one who identifies the hardware, and she does it with her hands before her mouth: she lifts a chain link in a gloved hand and weighs it. Her verdict is professional and unsentimental — this is quarry gear for dragging stone, not a barrier against animals — and then she draws the cost line that matters: one lever will not pull these spikes, it needs tools and more hands, and that means the crossing does not happen today. Doyun answers her the only way he knows: he tests the material himself, knocking the rock beside a spike with his sword hilt, hears a dull sound, and puts the blade back. He states the physical requirement, a hook that catches the spike head, because a rope alone will snap first. Maren adds, without blame, that the rope has already been used once yesterday. The reader should feel the day draining rather than a fight starting: no one is wrong, no one raises a voice, and the plan quietly dies of resources. End on Ria looking down the oil-smelling slope where half a load sits stalled, with the sun already tipping over.

beats.action: Maren hefts a single chain link in her gloved hand, frowning as the weight tells her something, then names the hardware for what it is: quarry equipment for hauling stone, never meant to keep beasts out.
She lets the chain drop, slaps the dust off her palms, and converts the problem into labor and time: one lever is not enough, spikes need tools and extra hands, so today's crossing is off.
Doyun checks her verdict against the rock itself, rapping the stone next to a spike with his sword hilt; the answer comes back dull and solid, and he seats the blade again.
He states the missing piece of gear: something that hooks over the spike head, since a rope pulled straight would part before the iron moves.
Maren closes the last exit quietly, noting the rope in question was already spent once yesterday; she is stating inventory, not assigning fault.
With the sun tipping, Ria turns from the talk to look down the slope that still smells of oil, at the load halted partway up, and the lost half-day lands on her.

facts.statement: Maren lifts one link of the chain with a gloved hand and gauges its weight; her eyebrows draw together.
Maren recognizes this type of link: it is quarry gear used for dragging stone, not equipment made to block animals.
She puts the chain down and brushes off her palms.
Maren states a single lever will not pull the spikes out; extracting them needs tools and more hands, and therefore the crossing cannot be made today.
Doyun knocks the rock beside an iron spike with the hilt of his sword; the sound is dull. He then puts the sword back.
Doyun states a hook is needed to catch on the spike head, because pulling with a rope would break the rope first.
Maren adds that that rope was already used once the day before; her tone is not accusatory.
The sun has already begun to sink; Ria looks down the slope below, where the smell of oil still lingers.
Half a day is gone and the cargo, having come roughly halfway up, is stopped.

units.text: “이걸 치우면 사슴은 아래로 내려가요. 길목이 비면 사람은 위로 지나가고요. 싸울 일이 없어져요.”
“내일 아침에 이 길로 다시 온다고 칩시다.”
마렌이 어깨에서 자루 끈을 내려 손에 쥐고 말했다.
“그럼 저는 오늘 내린 짐을 다시 싣고, 또 지고 올라와야 합니다. 한 번은 하죠. 두 번은 못 합니다.”
도윤이 리아 앞에 섰다.
“왜 하필 이 길이야. 다리 남쪽으로도 능선은 붙어. 넌 어제부터 이쪽만 봤어.”
리아는 대답하려고 입을 열었다.
바위틈 안쪽, 사슬 너머 벽에 빗물이 지나간 자리가 있었다. 그 아래 끝이 두 갈래로 갈라진 화살표. 그리고 밑에 손톱만 한 짧은 선 하나.
어제 본 것과 같은 손이었다. 새긴 지 오래된 것도, 어제 것도 아니었다.
리아의 목에 감긴 보리의 꼬리가 한 번 조여졌다.
보리가 사슬 너머 어둠을 보다가 리아의 귀 옆에서 낮게 소리를 냈다. 도망갈 때 내는 소리는 아니었다.
“리아.”
도윤이 다시 불렀다.
“근거를 말해. 아니면 여기까지야.”

plan.intent: The scene where a plan that sounds clean on paper gets priced by the people who would have to pay for it, and then the real reason behind it stays hidden. Ria lays out her logic in three short clauses: pull the chain, the deer drop to the lower ground, the emptied neck of the trail lets people cross above, and nobody has to fight anything. It is a good plan. Maren answers it not with objection but with arithmetic of her own back: she slides the sack strap off her shoulder into her hand, imagines coming back up this same path tomorrow morning, and states the ceiling plainly - she will reload and haul today's unloaded freight up once, never twice. Doyun does something colder. He plants himself in front of Ria and names the pattern he has been watching since yesterday: the ridge also joins south of the bridge, so why only this path, why has her gaze gone nowhere else. Ria opens her mouth to answer, and that is the moment the reader is pulled away from the argument to what she is actually seeing - past the chain, inside the rock slot, a rainwater track on the wall, a forked arrow under it, one fingernail-short line beneath that. The reader should recognize it before anyone speaks: this is the same hand as yesterday, and it is neither an old carving nor one made yesterday. Bori's tail cinches once on her neck, Bori stares into the dark past the chain and makes a low sound at her ear that is not the sound of running away. Then Doyun's voice again, using her name, closing the door: give grounds, or this ends here. The scene must end on Ria holding two answers - the honest one and the useful one - and on a demand she has not met.
plan.staging: Same location and same continuous stretch of the wet post-rain mountain day as the previous finished scene, on the old beast trail at the blocked narrow rock slot; weather, wetness and light must stay coherent with that scene. Confirmed spatial facts that must stay readable. (1) The obstruction is still the rusted thick-link chain hooked on iron spikes driven into the rock across the narrow slot, with the space beyond it dark and unresolved. (2) Exactly three humans are present - Ria, Doyun, Maren - plus Bori; no other people, no wagon, no draft animals, no additional bearers anywhere in the scene. (3) The freight unloaded earlier sits downhill on the approach slope the group climbed, stopped partway up; it must read as hand-carried freight, not vehicle-borne. (4) Maren begins this scene with a sack strap over her shoulder and ends with that strap off the shoulder and held in her hand; the sack itself does not have to leave her grip. (5) Doyun physically places himself in front of Ria before he speaks his challenge, so he is between her and whatever she had been facing. (6) Despite that, Ria retains a sightline into the interior of the rock slot past the chain - the artist decides whether she sees past him, around him, or turns; the mark is inside, on the wall beyond the chain, not on the chain or on the outer face. (7) On that interior wall, three things stack vertically in this order top to bottom: a track where rainwater ran down, a small arrow whose tip end splits into two branches, and one very short line roughly a fingernail long. The mark is small and easy to miss at conversational distance. (8) Bori is on or against Ria's upper body with its tail wrapped around her neck, close enough that its low sound lands beside her ear; Bori's gaze goes into the dark beyond the chain. Tone is a working dispute turning into an interrogation, not a shouting match. Panel shapes, cutting, camera distances and vertical rhythm are the artist's choice; prefer fewer, larger, clearly legible panels.
uncertainties: Who cut the marking, when, and what it means are unstated. Add no maker, no signature, no additional glyphs, no legend, no map pulled out to compare.
The source says the carving is neither old nor from yesterday. Do not resolve this into a visible timestamp, fresh dust, wet tool scoring or any dating cue beyond the plain incised shapes.
Nothing states that Doyun, Maren or anyone but Ria sees or is shown the marking in these units. Do not stage them noticing it, pointing at it, or reacting to it.

Ria delivers no answer to Doyun's question in these units. Give her no dialogue after ch-2-p-65 and no thought balloon; her withholding reads only through the opened mouth, posture and where she looks.
The deer are referred to in speech only. Do not show deer, hooves, droppings, a herd or any animal beyond Bori.
The ridge south of the bridge is named in dialogue only. Do not render it, signpost it, or add a wide establishing view that claims its geography.

Bori's low sound is explicitly not a flight sound, but its meaning is not given. No discharge, no sparks, no crackle, no glow, no gesture that points to a specific threat or direction beyond looking into the dark.
Nothing in these units states the chain is loosened, cut, lifted or in any way moved. Show no progress on the obstruction and no tool being applied.
Whether a lever, rope or other gear is physically on screen is unstated here; if present keep it idle and do not stage damage or failure.
Maren's refusal is a limit on her own labor, not an accusation against Ria or Doyun. Do not draw it as a sneer, a shove, or abandoning the sack in anger.
The exact contents of the unloaded freight are unspecified in these units. Keep it readable as stalled hand-carried load without inventing named goods or new containers.
POV is limited to Ria, so Doyun's and Maren's inner states are unnarrated. Render them through posture, hands on gear or strap, and their quoted lines only.
Ria's right sleeve and wrist are not raised or discussed here. Do not reveal, outline or silhouette anything on that wrist and do not let the sleeve slip.
No decision, detour, new marker, camp choice or departure is reached in these units. Do not close on a resolution, a handshake, a raised map or anyone walking off.
