beats.action: Ria sells the plan in its cleanest form - remove the chain, the deer go down, the emptied path lets people cross above, and the fight never has to happen.

Maren does not argue the logic; she slides the sack strap down off her shoulder into her hand and prices the plan against her own body - if they come back up here tomorrow morning she must reload and haul today's dropped freight again, and she will pay that once, not twice.

Doyun steps into Ria's path and names the thing nobody else has: another ridge connects south of the bridge, so the choice of this route is not obvious, and her attention has been fixed here since yesterday.

Ria opens her mouth to answer, and instead her attention snags on the wall inside the rock slot past the chain: a rainwater track, a two-branched arrow beneath it, and one fingernail-short line below that.
She recognizes the hand that cut it as the same one from yesterday, and registers that the cutting is neither old nor from yesterday, which quietly makes the whole route question personal.
Bori's tail cinches once around her neck; Bori stares into the dark beyond the chain and makes a low sound at her ear - not the sound that means run.
Doyun says her name again and closes the exit: grounds, or the route ends here - leaving Ria holding a reason she has not chosen to hand over.

facts.statement: Ria's stated plan has three linked steps: clear the chain, the deer move down to lower ground, the emptied neck of the trail lets people pass above, so no fight is needed.
Maren takes the sack strap off her shoulder and holds it in her hand before she speaks.

Maren raises the hypothetical of returning by this path tomorrow morning: it would mean reloading the freight unloaded today and carrying it up again. She will do that once and refuses to do it twice.
Doyun moves and positions himself in front of Ria.
Doyun points out that the ridge also connects south of the bridge, and that Ria has been looking only toward this side since yesterday.
Ria opens her mouth intending to answer him, and no answer is delivered in this scene.

Inside the rock slot, on the wall beyond the chain, there is a track left by running rainwater; below it an arrow whose end splits into two branches; below that a single short line about the length of a fingernail.
Ria judges the marking to be by the same hand as the one she saw yesterday, and to be neither long-carved nor made yesterday.
Bori's tail is wrapped around Ria's neck and tightens once.
Bori looks at the darkness beyond the chain, then makes a low sound beside Ria's ear; it is not the sound Bori makes when fleeing.
Doyun calls Ria's name a second time and sets a condition: state the grounds, otherwise it ends here.

brief.style: Finished full-color fantasy comic, expressive ink lines, wet post-rain mountain trail, adult cast plus small marten; Korean lettering drawn inside image; fewer, larger, legible panels.

moments.action: Ria stands before the rusted thick-link chain hooked on iron spikes across the narrow rock slot, one hand lifted toward it as she lays out her plan.
Maren, speaking, slides the sack strap down off her shoulder into her gripping hand; the sack stays held, her eyes level and unangry on Ria.
Doyun has planted himself squarely in front of Ria on the narrow wet trail, blocking her forward line, speaking down at her with hands empty.
Past Doyun's shoulder: Ria's mouth has just opened, but her gaze slips beyond the chain into the dim slot, where faint cut marks sit on wet wall.
Tight close on that interior wall: a rainwater track, beneath it a small arrow whose tip splits in two branches, beneath that one fingernail-short line. Nothing else.
Bori's tail cinches once around Ria's neck; the marten, pressed against her shoulder, muzzle near her ear, stares into the darkness beyond the chain.
Doyun, still squared in front of Ria, speaks her name and his condition; her mouth is closed now, her eyes still not on him.

units.text: 도윤의 말이 바위 벽에 붙어 떨어지지 않았다.
근거를 말해. 아니면 여기까지야.
해는 이미 능선 뒤로 넘어가 있었고, 사슬 너머에서만 찬 바람이 나왔다. 불을 피우지 않았다. 연기가 아래로 가면 사슴이 먼저 온다. 마렌은 약 상자 끈을 다시 매고, 밀가루 자루를 손으로 짚어 셋을 확인했다. 보리는 상자 뚜껑의 마른 자리를 차지한 채 내려오지 않았다. 리아가 손바닥을 내밀자 작은 앞발이 손가락을 밀어냈다. 자리를 내줄 생각은 없었다.
아무도 비탈을 내려가지 않았다. 내려가면 내일이 두 번째가 되었다.
새벽빛이 바위틈 입구에 닿았을 때도 사슬은 그대로였다. 돌은 밤새 식어 손바닥에 차가웠다. 리아는 방패 손잡이를 쥐려다 오른손목이 먼저 접히는 것을 느꼈다. 소매 안으로 손을 밀어 넣었다가, 도윤의 시선이 그 손목에 가 있는 것을 알고 동작을 멈췄다.
도윤은 칼자루를 한 번 쓸고, 퇴로가 없는 말을 기다렸다. 더 재촉하지는 않았다.

plan.intent: The reader should feel a demand that will not drop, then a cold unlit halt beside a chain, then dawn proving nothing moved. Overnight they refuse the slope. At first light the injury in Lia's right wrist is seen; Doyun waits for a statement that names a way back, and no one answers.
plan.staging: A rock-walled gap holds the party. A chain is present in that gap. Wind is felt only on the far side of the chain. After sunset the camp is unlit: a medicine box with a strap and lid, and three flour sacks Maren can touch. Bori is on the dry lid; Lia can offer a palm to that lid. A slope below the gap stays empty and is not the same place as the later dawn entrance. Night comes first; dawn light then reaches the rock-gap entrance with the chain still in place. A palm can meet cooled stone. Lia can reach a shield grip with her right hand near a sleeve. Doyun can have a sword hilt within reach. Leave unspecified: how the chain is fastened, what it blocks, distances, any route beyond the chain, and any side path or outpost. Do not light a fire. Do not show a descent. Do not show a spoken answer.

Who chose not to light a fire, and who stated the smoke-and-deer reason, are unnamed in ch-3-p-3.

What it would mean for tomorrow to become a second time is not mapped as geography.

After the sun is behind the ridge, the halt stays dark; cold wind arrives only from the far side of the chain, and no fire is made for the smoke-and-deer reason.
At the medicine box Maren reties the strap and checks three flour sacks by hand.
Bori keeps the dry lid and does not come down; Lia's offered palm is pushed away by a small forepaw, and the place is not yielded.

Dawn light reaches the rock-gap entrance; the chain is still as it was, and a palm finds the stone cold. Whose palm is unnamed.

textObservations.evidence: Panel 4 top-left caption; the final sentence reads '한 변이었다' where the source has '한 번이었다' (verified on an enlarged crop); the rest is exact.

textObservations.observedText: “지금!”
textObservations.evidence: Panel 5 balloon with tail to Lia shouting; the source names no speaker and c1 is a placeholder.

textObservations.observedText: 틈이 무릎 너비로 벌어졌다. 리아는 사슴 앞에 서지 않고 한 발 옆으로 붙어 열린 아래만 비켰다. 사슴이 그 어둠을 보더니 비탈로 빠졌다. 흙이 무너지고, 뿔이 나뭇가지를 부러뜨리는 소리가 멀리 내려갔다.
textObservations.evidence: Panel 5 top-right caption over the deer tumbling down the slope through branches; exact text.

review.evidence: Opened the actual r1 scene.png and the previous s4 image. Five full-width bordered rows read top to bottom, matching the resolved count. Six of seven texts are verbatim; text-5 has one syllable changed. Panel 1 adds an extra sound-effect lettering '콰르르…' for the rolling stones. Panel 2 shows antlers ahead of the fog and the deer's shoulders filling the slot with its eyes on the chain; panel 3 Doyun's weight on the rope with the chain still above and a dark gap below; panel 4 dust falling on Lia's hair as one angled teal shield takes the antler scrape; panel 5 Lia a step to the side while the deer drops onto the slope, earth giving way. No one passes the gap; no second shield. Same-host visual review by the orchestrating host (Claude Code), not an independent evaluation.

units.text: 줄이 딸려 내려갔다. 밀가루 자루가 비탈을 긁으며 미끄러졌다. 마렌이 약 상자를 끌어안았다. 한 자루가 그녀의 무릎을 쳤지만 상자는 놓지 않았다. 보리가 뚜껑 위에서 몸을 낮추고 꼬리만 리아 쪽으로 뻗었다. 그래도 상자에서 내리지 않았다.
“자루는 놔요!”
쇠테와 줄이 못 머리에 걸린 채 아래로 사라졌다. 철물을 건지려면 줄을 붙잡아야 했고, 줄을 붙잡으면 약이 미끄러졌다. 도윤이 손을 놓았다. 못은 반쯤 돌아간 채로 남았고, 아래 길은 열린 채였다.
사람은 사슬 밑으로 기어서 지나갔다. 짐승이 쓰던 높이와는 겹치지 않았다. 무릎이 젖은 돌에 닿을 때마다 약 상자 모서리가 바위에 긁혔다. 마렌이 상자 밑을 받치고, 도윤이 앞에서 사슬 고리를 손으로 들어 높이를 만들어 주었다. 리아는 뒤에서 방패를 들지 않았다. 이미 한 번 쓴 뒤였다. 빈 손이 더 빨랐다.
통로를 빠져나오자 옆길이 보였다. 사람 한 줄이 지나갈 너비였다. 리아가 벽에 스친 어깨로 화살표를 다시 보았다. 아래 갈래는 이제 실제로 열려 있었고, 옆 갈래는 그들의 무릎이 지난 자리였다. 아래로 떨어진 사슴의 소리는 이미 계곡 쪽으로 멀어져 있었다.
동쪽 비탈로 내려가는 동안 리아의 오른손목은 소매 안에서 맥없이 떨렸다. 방패 빛은 이미 꺼져 있었다. 짐을 나누었다. 약은 마렌, 남은 마른 식량은 도윤. 리아는 빈손에 가깝게 방패만 들었다. 보리가 상자 위에서 기어 가방 덮개 안으로 들어갔다. 기름 냄새에 코를 찡그리더니, 그래도 마른 안쪽을 포기하지는 않았다.
옆길은 젖었지만 사슴 자국과 겹치지 않았다. 짐승 길은 그 아래 비탈에 따로 나 있었고, 굽 자국과 사람 발자국은 더 이상 같은 흙을 밟지 않았다. 해가 어깨 높이까지 올라왔을 때 돌담이 보였다.

findings.ko: 6칸 캡션: “짐승 길은” → “짐송 길은”.
findings.en: Panel 6 caption renders '짐승 길은' (p41) as '짐송 길은', a non-word; the verbatim requirement is not met.

findings.ko: 5칸: 리아가 유리면 달린 실물 원형 방패를 듦. 방패는 이미 꺼진 빛일 뿐, 큰 소품 창작 금지(p40).
findings.en: Panel 5 draws Lia carrying a large physical round shield with a glassy face; the plan states her shield is only a light already gone out and forbids inventing a large new prop (p40).

findings.ko: 2칸: 고리가 또 리벳 철판에 걸림. 고리·줄·못 머리 외 하드웨어 금지(p37).
findings.en: Panel 2 again hangs the hoop on a large riveted iron plate; the plan explicitly forbids a large plate, rivets or new hardware beyond a hoop, rope and nail head (p37).

findings.ko: 6칸: 능선 위 탑 있는 성곽 도시. 원문은 돌담이 보였다(p41)뿐. 참조 이미지(옆길)에 먼 성곽 도시가 포함돼 유도.
findings.en: Panel 6 places a walled town with towers on the far ridge under the rising sun; p41 names only a stone wall becoming visible, and the plan forbids turning it into a village or outpost.

findings.ko: 5칸: 보리가 덮개 안으로 기어드는 게 아니라 가방 위에 앉음(p40). 마렌은 활짝 웃음.
findings.en: Panel 5 shows Bori perched on top of the closed bag rather than crawling in under the flap with a wrinkled nose (p40), and Maren grinning broadly while carrying the box.

findings.ko: 4칸: 벽에 스친 어깨(p39) 단서가 안 읽힘.
findings.en: Panel 4 shows Lia's mark-side shoulder clear of the wall rather than brushing it (p39), so the 'wall-brushed shoulder' cue is not readable.

plan.intent: The reader should feel cargo choose itself under a sliding slope: Maren keeps the medicine box while a sack hits her, someone tells the sacks to be dropped, Doyun opens his hands because holding the rope would let the medicine slip, then the group crawls under the chain at a height the beast did not use. After the passage, the side fork should read as the line their knees already took, loads should split without a second shield, Bori should pick the dry bag anyway, and the wet side path should no longer share earth with hoofprints until a stone wall appears with the sun at shoulder height.
plan.staging: Continue the same rock passage as the prior finished scene: chain still above, lower gap already open, existing rope and a mashed nail head, wet stone, a slope the sacks can scrape. Maren can hold a medicine box with Bori on the lid; flour sacks can hit her knee and slide away; the iron hoop and rope can vanish down while caught on that nail head; Doyun can let the rope go so the half-turned nail and open lower path remain. People can crawl under the chain at a height that does not overlap the height the beast used, with Maren supporting the box from below, Doyun in front lifting one chain ring by hand to make height, and Lia behind with empty hands and no raised shield. After the passage, a side path of one-person-line width can appear; an arrow mark can be seen again from a shoulder that brushed the wall; the lower fork can stay open as the deer's way while the side fork is the knee-path they used. They can descend an eastern slope with loads split: medicine with Maren, remaining dry food with Doyun, Lia close to empty-handed holding only a shield whose light is already out. Bori can crawl from the box into a bag flap. The wet side path can run apart from deer tracks on a lower slope. A stone wall can become visible only when the sun has risen to shoulder height. Keep clothing, faces, and props consistent with the supplied previous scene. Leave unspecified: cameras, panel rectangles, sack count beyond one that hits a knee, what the hoop was bound to, whose bag it is, the source of the oil smell, wound detail on the wrist, a second lit shield, extra hardware around the nail, the deer's body, valley scenery, and any outpost or interior beyond a visible stone wall.

How many flour sacks exist is unnamed beyond sliding sacks and one that hits a knee.
The iron hoop in ch-3-p-37 has no named size, cargo lashing, or extra fittings; do not invent a large plate, rivets, or new hardware beyond a hoop, rope, and nail head.
How holding the rope would make the medicine slip is unnamed as a physical coupling; show the named choice, not a new machine.
How far the hoop and rope fall is unnamed; they vanish downward, with no landing shown.
The chain ring Doyun lifts is unnamed in size and rust; show a ring he can raise by hand to make height, not a new gate.
The earlier single shield use is prior action; do not restage that catch or light a second shield.
Empty hands being faster does not name a dropped object besides not raising a shield.
The arrow mark in ch-3-p-39 is unnamed in color, maker, and meaning; show a mark that can be seen again, not a decoded map.
The valley exists only as a receding deer sound; do not cut away to a forest floor or a completed deer landing.
Wrist trembling in ch-3-p-40 is inside the sleeve and is not a described wound; do not invent injury detail.
The shield Lia holds while close to empty-handed is unnamed as a physical board or a dark tool; do not invent a large new prop, and keep the shield light already out.
Which bag Bori enters, and what smells of oil, are unnamed; do not invent labeled cargo.
The stone wall in ch-3-p-41 is visible only; do not turn it into an arrived outpost, village, or interior.
Shoulder-height sun belongs with the wall; do not jump to a later time of day before that beat.

textObservations.observedText: 옆길은 젖었지만 사슴 자국과 겹치지 않았다. 짐송 길은 그 아래 비탈에 따로 나 있었고, 굽 자국과 사람 발자국은 더 이상 같은 흙을 밟지 않았다. 해가 어깨 높이까지 올라왔을 때 돌담이 보였다.
textObservations.evidence: Panel 6 top caption; '짐승 길은' is rendered as '짐송 길은' (verified on a high-magnification crop); the rest is exact.

review.evidence: Opened the actual r1 scene.png and the previous s5 image. Six bordered panels in three rows of two; read left to right, top to bottom, matching the resolved count. Six of seven texts are verbatim; text-7 has one syllable changed. Panel 1 shows sacks sliding, Maren hugging the box, Bori flattened on the lid with its tail toward Lia; panel 2 the hoop and rope falling from the nail with Doyun's hands open; panel 3 Doyun lifting a chain ring ahead, Maren supporting the box, Lia last with empty hands; panel 4 Lia's shoulder at the forked arrow with the narrow ledge; panel 5 the loads split on the eastern slope; panel 6 the wet ledge path with a separate track below and a sunrise. Panel 2 hangs the hoop on a riveted iron plate; panel 5 gives Lia a large physical round shield; panel 6 shows a walled town with towers on the far ridge. Same-host visual review by the orchestrating host (Claude Code), not an independent evaluation.

units.text: 거점은 낮은 지붕과 굴뚝 연기였다. 문이 열리고, 기다린 사람이 약 상자의 봉인을 확인했다. 장부 옆에 빈 약장이 놓여 있었다. 봉인을 뜯지 않은 채 상자만 넘겨도 대기 줄이 움직였다. 상자가 바닥에 내려놓이자 마렌이 잃은 물건 수를 세다 말을 끊고, 숨을 길게 내쉬었다.
“도착했습니다. 기름은 못 가져왔고, 밀가루는 하나만 남았습니다. 약은 그대로예요.”
받는 사람이 길잡이 표식을 확인하고 장부에 줄을 그었다. 첫 공동 의뢰의 끝은 박수보다 서명에 가까웠다. 도윤이 이름을 적고, 남은 사람 수를 세듯 세 사람을 돌아보았다.
마렌이 장갑을 벗고 손가락을 접었다. 기름, 밀가루, 줄, 쇠테. 넷을 세다 다섯에서 멈추고 입을 다물었다.
“별거 아닙니다. 다시 벌면…….”
그녀는 그 다음을 잇지 않았다.
“약은 들어갔으니까.”

findings.ko: 3칸 캡션: “길잡이 표식을” → “길잡이 표석을”. 표식이 돌 표지로 바뀜.
findings.en: Panel 3 caption renders '길잡이 표식을' (p44) as '길잡이 표석을', changing 'mark' to 'stone marker'; the verbatim requirement is not met.

findings.ko: 1칸 배경: 산등성이 위 탑 있는 성곽 도시. 낮은 지붕과 굴뚝 연기만 허용(p42). 참조 이미지 유도.
findings.en: Panel 1 background places a towered castle-town on the mountain ridge behind the outpost; the plan explicitly forbids adding towers or a walled town beyond low roofs and chimney smoke (p42).

findings.ko: 2칸 “남았습니다”에 잡획 하나, 5칸 “벌면…….”에 마침표 하나 추가. 읽히지만 정확 렌더링 아님.
findings.en: Panel 2 balloon has a stray horizontal stroke inside '남았습니다', and panel 5 has an extra period after the ellipsis in '다시 벌면…….'; both are legible but not clean verbatim lettering.

findings.ko: 3칸: 도윤이 장부만 봄. 세 사람을 돌아보는 동작(p44)이 별도 비트로 없음.
findings.en: Panel 3 shows Doyun still looking down at the ledger while writing; the turn to look at three people (p44) is not shown as a distinct beat.

findings.ko: 3칸: 길잡이 표식이 책상 위 돌판으로 그려짐. 원문은 위치 미지정. 창작 소품.
findings.en: Panel 3 draws the pathfinder mark as a carved stone tablet placed on the desk; the source does not locate the mark, so this is an invented host object, though not a decoded map.

plan.intent: The reader should feel the first joint job close as a handoff and a ledger line, not a cheer. A sealed medicine box is enough to move a waiting line, while Maren’s losses stay a count she cannot finish calling small. Doyun treats the people still there the way he treats a remaining headcount.
plan.staging: This excerpt reaches the outpost: low roofs and chimney smoke, not the rock passage. A door can open onto a space that holds a ledger, an empty medicine cabinet beside that ledger, a waiting line, and a floor where the medicine box can be set down. The box keeps its seal; the seal is checked and the box is handed over unopened. Do not show oil, extra flour, rope, or the iron hoop as cargo still in hand; they exist only in the count. Maren can remove gloves and fold fingers. A receiving person can check a pathfinder mark and draw a line in the ledger. Doyun can write a name and turn to look at three people. Keep clothing, faces, and the medicine box consistent with the supplied previous scene. Do not add towers, a walled town, applause, a second time of day, or a return to chains. Leave unspecified: cameras, panel rectangles, whether the waiting person and the receiving person are the same body, where the pathfinder mark sits, whose name is written, who the three people are, who set the box down, interior architecture beyond the named objects, daylight beyond coherence with chimney smoke, and whether Bori is on-panel.
uncertainties: The speakers of text-2, text-5, and text-7 are unnamed in ch-3-p-43, ch-3-p-46, and ch-3-p-48; the c4 ids are lettering placeholders, not source identifications. Do not lock those lines to a confirmed mouth.
ch-3-p-42 names a waiting person and ch-3-p-44 names a receiving person; the source does not say they are the same person or two people.
Who sets the box on the floor in ch-3-p-42 is unnamed.
The pathfinder mark in ch-3-p-44 has no named location, color, maker, or meaning; show a mark that can be checked, not a decoded map.
Whose name Doyun writes in ch-3-p-44 is unnamed.
The three people Doyun looks at in ch-3-p-44 are unnamed; do not invent a roll call or force unmentioned business onto anyone.
The fifth item in Maren’s count in ch-3-p-45 is unnamed; she stops at five with her mouth closed. Do not invent the missing object.
Oil, flour beyond the one remaining named in text-2, rope, and the iron hoop are lost or absent as delivered cargo; do not restage them on the floor as recovered goods.
The waiting line’s size and who stands in it are unnamed beyond the fact that it moves.
Time of day is unnamed in this excerpt; keep light coherent with chimney smoke and do not jump to night or a later hour.
Bori is unnamed in these units; presence or absence is not a source fact.
The comparison to applause in ch-3-p-44 is not an applause event; do not draw a crowd clapping.
Low roofs and chimney smoke do not name a town of towers, battlements, or a large village; do not expand the outpost past what the units show.

Inside the outpost, the arrival report is spoken: oil not brought, only one flour remaining, medicine unchanged.

units.text: 조끼 안주머니에서 접힌 가죽 조각이 나왔다. 다음 구간 길이었다. 끊긴 자리에 같은 손이 있었다. 두 갈래 화살표, 짧은 선. 가장자리는 닳아 있었고, 화살표의 꺾인 각이 벽의 것과 같았다. 짧은 선의 깊이도 같았다.
리아의 시선이 그 선에서 멈췄다. 그 손을 알아보는 이유는 입에 올리지 않았다. 말하면 길이 다시 자기 것이 될 것 같았다. 도윤이 그 얼굴을 보았지만, 이번에는 이름을 묻지 않았다.
“리아.”
마렌이 가죽 모서리를 문질렀다.
“이 조각, 동쪽 다음으로 넘어가는 길입니다. 혼자 가면 또 막혀요. 같이 가겠다면, 짐은 제가 맞출게요.”
리아가 손목을 움직여 보았다. 저림이 남아 있었다. 새긴 손은 말하지 않았고, 사슬을 박은 자도 아직 벽에 없었다.
“같이 가요, 마렌 씨. 다음이 어디로 붙는지만 먼저 봐요.”
도윤이 칼집을 한 번 쓸고 끄덕였다. 가방 속에서 보리가 작게 울었다. 꾸. 반대하지 않는 소리였다.
거점 뒤편으로 길이 이어져 있었다. 같은 표식이 그 입구 돌에도 희미했다.

findings.ko: 5칸 캡션: “이어져 있었다” → “이여져 있었다”.
findings.en: Panel 5 caption renders '길이 이어져 있었다' (p57) as '길이 이여져 있었다'; the verbatim requirement is not met.

findings.ko: 1칸: 가죽 조각에 손바닥 자국이 찍힘. “같은 손이 있었다”(p49)는 같은 사람 솜씨라는 뜻. 각색 계획이 “a hand”로 오독.
findings.en: Panel 1 stamps a literal palm print on the leather scrap; '끊긴 자리에 같은 손이 있었다' (p49) means the same maker's hand, not a handprint, so the image invents a glyph that changes the source's meaning.

findings.ko: 5칸 배경: 다시 탑 있는 성곽 도시. 계획은 탑·성곽 도시 금지(p57). 참조 이미지 유도.
findings.en: Panel 5 background shows a towered walled town on the ridge behind the rear path; the plan explicitly forbids adding towers or a walled town (p57 names only a path and an entrance stone).

findings.ko: 5칸: 입구 돌의 표식이 크고 선명. 원문은 희미했다(p57).
findings.en: Panel 5 carves the entrance-stone mark boldly and large; p57 describes the same mark as faint (희미했다).

findings.ko: 3·4칸: 마렌이 따뜻하게 미소. 원문 어조는 담담.
findings.en: Panels 3 and 4 give Maren a warm smile while offering to match the loads; the source tone is plain and unemphatic, so the expression is softer than the text.

plan.intent: The reader should feel a finished delivery reopen through a scrap of leather, not through a confession. Lia recognizes a hand on the fragment and keeps the reason unsaid so the road does not become hers alone. Maren turns that scrap into a shared crossing and offers to match the loads. Doyun answers with a scabbard and a nod instead of a name. A small cry from the bag does not block them. The first attach point is only the path behind the outpost.
plan.staging: This excerpt stays at the outpost reached in the previous scene, then reaches a path behind that outpost. A vest with an inner pocket can yield a folded leather piece. The piece can show a broken place with a hand, a two-pronged arrow, a short line, and a worn edge. Those marks can be seen well enough to compare bent angle and line depth with a wall mark; do not move the scene to the rusted-chain rock passage to stage that likeness. Lia can look at the short line. Doyun can see her face. Maren can rub the leather corner while the piece is in play. Lia can move a wrist. Doyun has a scabbard he can sweep. A bag is present; Bori can remain inside it and cry from there. Behind the outpost a path continues; an entrance stone can carry a faint mark of the same kind. Keep faces, clothing, and packs consistent with the supplied previous scene. Do not add towers, a walled town, a second time of day, applause, decoded map notes, or a return to chains. Leave unspecified: cameras, panel rectangles, whose vest, who draws the piece out, whether the compared wall is on-panel, which wall still lacks the chain-driver, whose bag, whether anyone steps onto the rear path, and interior versus yard as long as the outpost and its rear path remain the place.
uncertainties: ch-3-p-49 does not name whose vest it is or whose hand draws the piece out.
The wall used for the angle and depth match in ch-3-p-49 is unnamed as a present location; likeness is a fact, not a license to restage the chained rock passage.
What the hand on the piece is the same as, beyond the source's claim of sameness, is unnamed; do not letter a guessed identity.
The speaker of text-3 is unnamed in ch-3-p-51; the c4 id is a lettering placeholder, not a source identification.
The speaker of text-5 is unnamed in ch-3-p-53; ch-3-p-52 names Maren rubbing the corner immediately before; the c4 id remains a lettering placeholder.
The speaker of text-7 is unnamed in ch-3-p-55; ch-3-p-54 names Lia immediately before and the line addresses Maren; the c1 id is a lettering placeholder, not a locked mouth.
The name Doyun does not ask in ch-3-p-50 is unnamed; do not invent lettering for it.
Which wall still lacks the chain-driver in ch-3-p-54 is unnamed.
The one who drove in the chains is unnamed and absent; do not invent a face or put that person on the wall.
Whose bag holds Bori in ch-3-p-56 is unnamed.
ch-3-p-57 says the path continues behind the outpost; it does not say anyone walks it in this excerpt.
Time of day is unnamed; keep light coherent with the prior outpost and do not jump to night or a later hour.

beats.action: A folded leather piece comes out of a vest inner pocket as the next section of the road; at the broken place is the same hand, a two-pronged arrow and a short line; the edge is worn, and the arrow's bent angle and the short line's depth match the wall's.

Lia's gaze stops on the short line; she does not speak the reason she recognizes the hand, because speaking feels as if the road would become hers again; Doyun sees that face and this time does not ask the name.

The spoken line recorded as text-3 occurs; Maren rubs the leather corner; the spoken line recorded as text-5 offers the piece as the road past the east, warns that going alone will be blocked again, and offers to match the loads if they go together.
Lia moves her wrist; numbness remains; the carved hand does not speak, and the one who drove in the chains is still not on the wall.
The spoken line recorded as text-7 accepts going together and limits the first step to seeing where the next piece attaches.
Doyun sweeps the scabbard once and nods; Bori cries softly from inside a bag; the cry recorded as text-9 is a sound that does not oppose.
A path continues behind the outpost, and the same mark is faint on the stone at that entrance.

episodes.title: 잉크가 장부 위에서 아직 젖어 있었다
episodes.note: 소설·아크 2 설계·각색 모두 grok-4.7. 각색은 s1 계획·검증만 reasoning high(계획 ~7분·검증 ~8분), s2부터 medium으로 전환. s1 direction의 일정 문구가 사전 검증을 차단해 발췌 중립 문구로 교체 후 새 워크플로로 시작. 배경 참조 2장 중 1장(ref-outpost)은 3화 참조 재사용, 1장(ref-rear-bend)은 이 run에서 새로 생성(generate, medium).

units.text: 잉크가 장부 위에서 아직 젖어 있었다. 약 상자는 빈 약장 안으로 들어가 봉인째 놓였고, 마렌의 손에는 가죽 조각이 그대로였다. 리아가 방금 한 말, 다음이 어디로 붙는지만 먼저 보자는 그 문장이 마당 공기에 남아 있었다. 거점 뒤편 입구 돌에는 같은 표식이 희미했다.
리아가 그쪽으로 한 발을 옮기다 오른손을 펼쳤다. 손가락이 끝까지 열리지 않았다. 방패 끈을 잡으려다 놓쳤고, 저린 손목이 소매 안에서 맥없이 접혔다. 리아는 반대손으로 소매를 끌어내려 그 자리를 가렸다. 턱 아래의 밤색 머리가 귀 뒤로 흘렀다.
손목은 세지 않았다.

밀가루 자루는 하나, 입구를 접어 마렌의 발치에 서 있었다. 기름통 자리는 젖은 돌 자국뿐이었다. 도윤의 허리춤은 비어 있었다. 줄을 걸던 고리만 남았고, 쇠테가 닿던 가죽은 색이 옅었다. 리아의 가방은 가볍고, 덮개 안 마른 천 위에 보리가 몸을 둥글리고 있었다. 크림색 등만 보였고, 보리는 제 앞발로 덮개 끝을 끌어다 빛 위에 덮었다. 마른 자리를 혼자 지키려는 몸짓이었다.
마렌이 조각을 도윤 쪽에 건넸다.
“도윤 씨. 돌부터 보세요. 자루는 제가 묶어요.”
장갑을 다시 끼고, 처마 아래 못에 걸린 예비 끈을 빌려 밀가루 자루에 둘렀다. 끈이 짧았다. 당기자 천 모서리가 안으로 패였고, 하얀 먼지가 끈 위로 배어 나왔다.
“느슨하면 또 미끄러져요.”
말이 끝나기 전에 한 번 더 당겼다.

findings.ko: 7칸: 도윤 허리에 둘둘 말린 줄. 원문 p4는 허리춤이 비고 고리만 남음. 3화에서 잃은 줄이 되살아남.
findings.en: Panel 7 shows a full coiled rope hanging from Doyun's belt. ch-4-p-4 states his waist is empty with only the ring that used to hold the rope left, and beat-waist / moment 6 require the empty waist; the lost rope from the previous chapter is drawn back in.

findings.ko: 3칸: 리아가 표식 돌에 오른손을 활짝 펴 짚음. 원문 p2는 손가락이 끝까지 안 펴지고 방패 끈을 놓치는 장면. 창작 동작.
findings.en: Panel 3 shows Ria crouched with her right hand pressed flat on the marked stone, fingers fully spread. ch-4-p-2 and beat-step have her only moving one foot toward the stone while her right fingers fail to open fully and miss the shield strap; the stone touch is an invented action that contradicts the failed grip the scene is about.

findings.ko: 2·3칸: 표식이 선명하게 새겨짐. 원문 p1은 '희미했다'.
findings.en: Panels 2 and 3 carve the forked arrow and short line boldly and clearly on the stone; ch-4-p-1 says the same mark is only faint on the rear-entrance stone.

findings.ko: 8칸: 보리 얼굴이 정면. 원문 p4는 크림색 등만 보이고 앞발로 덮개를 끌어당김.
findings.en: Panel 8 shows Bori's whole face turned to the viewer with the paw on the cover; ch-4-p-4 and moment 7 have only the cream back visible while the paw draws the cover edge over the light.

findings.ko: 1·9칸: 가죽 조각이 구멍 뚫린 벨트 끈으로 그려짐. 브리프가 '가죽 조각'만 적고 표식이 있는 지도 조각임을 안 알림.
findings.en: Panels 1 and 9 draw the leather piece as a plain belt strap with punched holes; the source piece is the worn map fragment carrying the same forked mark, so it does not read as the piece Maren hands over.

plan.intent: A finished full-color fantasy comic with expressive ink lines, an adult cast, and a small cream marten, in damp daylight at the mountain outpost. The reader stays in the quiet hold after the rescue: wet ink, a faint rear mark, Ria's hand missing the shield strap, one flour sack and a wet trace, Bori keeping a dry cloth, and Maren sending Doyun to the stone while she cinches that sack with a strap that is short.
plan.staging: Shared instant: beat-ground and beat-waist, the co-present sack, wet trace, and empty waist in ch-4-p-4, one still whose beats list empty textIds. panelCount 10 places that pair in a single instant and keeps beat-ink, beat-linger, beat-step, beat-fail, beat-hide, beat-bori, beat-pass, beat-wrap, and beat-yank as nine further instants. beat-ink carries only text-ink and already holds the sealed box and the leather in Maren's hand. beat-linger carries only text-linger. beat-step, then beat-fail, then beat-hide stay in that order. beat-bori stays on its own with text-bori. beat-pass carries only the three-clause line text-assign. beat-wrap is the gloved hold after the first pull, and beat-yank is the later pull during text-slip. The leather stays in Maren's hand from beat-ink until beat-pass. Gloves begin at beat-wrap. The spare strap comes from a nail under the eave. Ledger, cabinet, courtyard, and rear-entrance stone are all present, and their distances stay free. The artist chooses framing, panel shapes, and a natural vertical reading order.
uncertainties: ch-4-p-1 leaves the distances among the ledger, the medicine cabinet, the courtyard, and the rear-entrance stone unstated. The mark's shape and any design on the leather piece stay unstated.
The verb in ch-4-p-3 stays unresolved among strength, severity, and counting. text-wrist is lettered verbatim on beat-hide with that reading left open.
ch-4-p-2 establishes the shield strap only through the missed grasp, so its mount stays unstated. The movement is one foot toward the stone. Arrival stays outside the excerpt.
ch-4-p-4 leaves unstated whether Ria's bag is worn or set down. The light on the dry cloth is ordinary falling daylight.
ch-4-p-5 leaves Doyun's grip unstated. His look toward the stone stays outside the excerpt. beat-pass is the extension together with the spoken assignment.
ch-4-p-6 and ch-4-p-8 leave the speaker unnamed. The speaker is c4 because ch-4-p-5 names Maren as she extends the leather, and the tying in ch-4-p-7 through ch-4-p-9 continues that actor.
ch-4-p-7 leaves its grammatical subject unnamed. The gloves, the borrowed eave strap, and both pulls continue c4's offer to tie the sack.

review.evidence: Ten panels in four rows read left to right, top to bottom. Row 1: wet ledger with Maren's bare hand holding a leather strip and a sealed box in the cabinet; the rear-entrance stone with a carved forked mark beside the rutted path. Row 2: Ria crouched with her right hand spread flat on the marked stone; Ria's right hand curled at the chest strap; Ria drawing her sleeve down with the left hand, chestnut hair behind her ear. Row 3: one folded flour sack beside Doyun's boots on wet stone; Doyun's waist with a coiled rope hanging from the belt; Bori's face and paw at the bag cover. Row 4: Maren extends the leather strip to Doyun; two close-ups of gloved hands cinching a strap around the sack with a dented corner and white dust. Setting, light and costumes stay consistent across panels; Lia (chestnut bob, amber eyes, sand jacket), Doyun (black hair, grey eyes, green coat) and Maren (red-brown curls, brick vest) match the references.

units.text: 도윤은 매듭에 손을 대지 않았다. 가죽 조각을 쥔 채, 시선만 자기 허리의 빈 고리에 갔다가 돌아왔다. 왼쪽 눈썹의 끊긴 자리가 잠깐 모였다. 리아는 그 손이 매듭으로 가지 않는 것과, 말이 짧은 것을 먼저 보았다.
“마렌 씨. 손힘이 버릇이 되셨습니다. 모서리 보세요. 한 고리만 빼요.”
마렌의 당기던 손이 멈췄다. 빈 고리를 보던 눈이 잃은 줄을 세다 멈췄고, 입은 다음 수를 내지 않았다. 매듭을 한 고리 풀자 자루 모서리가 다시 부풀었다. 끈은 그대로 팽팽했다. 천은 버티고 있었다.
“한 고리요. 이 끈이 지금 전부라서요.”
“던질 건 없습니다.”
도윤이 빈 고리를 엄지로 누르고 손을 뗐다. 조각의 두 갈래 화살표를 입구 돌 쪽으로 돌렸다.

findings.ko: 6칸: 마렌 대사 “한 고리요…”가 보리만 있는 칸에 붙음. 원문 p10~15에 보리 없음. 화자 오귀속 + 창작 등장.
findings.en: Panel 6 puts Maren's line text-oneloop over a panel that shows only Bori in the bag; moment 6 has Maren speaking once the loop is loose, and Bori does not appear anywhere in ch-4-p-10..15. The speaker cannot be read and the marten is an invented subject for this scene.

plan.intent: At the damp mountain outpost, Doyun will not touch the sack knot. He checks the empty ring at his waist, then limits the pull to a single loop. The sack corner recovers while the cord stays taut and the cloth holds. Nothing is thrown. He then turns the leather piece's forked arrow toward the entrance stone.
plan.staging: The knot is on the cord around the sack. The empty ring is on Doyun's waist. The entrance stone is the entrance stone named in ch-4-p-15. Distances among Ria, Doyun, Maren, the sack, and the stone stay free, and he aims from where he already stands. Daylight stays as it is. panelCount 10. beat-to-ring is the first instant and beat-return the second, so the glance finishes before any speech. beat-notice is the next instant and the only carrier of text-habit. beat-stop is the next instant, with no lettering. beat-swell and beat-hold share the next instant, with no lettering and with Doyun's hand off the knot. beat-limit is the next instant and the only carrier of text-oneloop. beat-throw is the next instant and the only carrier of text-throw. beat-press, beat-release, and beat-aim are the last three instants in that order, each with no lettering. The ring stays empty. No rope, throw, spill, or tally appears. The artist chooses framing, panel shapes, and vertical reading order.
uncertainties: ch-4-p-11, ch-4-p-13, and ch-4-p-14 do not name a speaker. text-habit is carried as c2 because Ria registers a short speech after his withheld hand and the line addresses Maren; a c1 reading stays possible. text-oneloop is carried as c4 as the cord reply after the stopped pull. text-throw is carried as c2 because it immediately precedes his named thumb in ch-4-p-15.

ch-4-p-12 does not name whose eyes were on the empty ring or whose mouth withheld the next count. The stopped hand is Maren's. Doyun also looked at that ring in ch-4-p-10, so the halted eyes may be his. No numeral is lettered, and the lost line is not on the ring.
ch-4-p-12 does not name who loosens the one loop. The shared swell instant shows the loose loop and the swollen corner only.

ch-4-p-15 does not name which thumb presses the ring or which hand holds the piece. Either a one-hand or a two-hand pose fits. It does not state that the entrance stone is the rear-entrance stone, that any trace is on it, or that anyone approaches it.

Row 2: Maren's gloved hand resting on the sack cord; the sack tied with rope beside the gloved hand holding the leather piece; Bori in the bag under Maren's balloon. units.text: 거점 앞길에서 바퀴 소리가 겹쳐 왔다. 사슬이 있던 쪽이었다. 아래만 열어 둔 그 길로 보급 수레가 올라오고 있었다. 첫 수레가 마당 입구를 채우자 옆판의 흠이 해에 떴다. 뿔이 긁은 자리였다. 창백한 속살이 드러나 있고, 가장자리는 아직 축축했다. 긴 자국 하나, 그 아래 짧은 자국 둘, 끝에서 방향을 바꾸다 겹친 자국 하나. 되돌아선 자리가 나무에 그대로였다. 리아는 그 수를 입 안에서만 굴렸다. 넷.

둘째 수레가 뒤를 막았고, 셋째가 처마 그늘까지 밀고 들어왔다. 짐 덮개가 서로의 그림자를 덮자 마당의 빈 돌이 사라졌다. 끌리던 짐승이 제자리에서 발을 구르며 먹이 주머니를 흔들었고, 짐승 땀과 젖은 포대 냄새가 코끝에 섞였다. 마당이 수레로 막히자 뒤편으로 나가던 바람이 끊겼다. 수레를 몬 사람들은 일행 대신 장부 탁자만 보았다. 고삐를 잡은 손이 탁자 쪽을 향한 채, 마당은 말없이 그 칸만 기다렸다.
가방이 흔들렸다.
보리가 덮개를 밀어 올리고 귀부터 내밀었다. 코가 수레가 올라온 길, 사슬이 있던 쪽을 가리켰다. 짧은 앞발이 리아의 소매를 밀쳤다.
“키익.”
한 번으로 끝나지 않았다. 꼬리 끝이 제 목으로 말려 올라갔고, 같은 방향을 향해 다시 울었다.
“꾸. 키익.”
목덜미의 크림색 털이 곤두서며, 손등을 따끔하게 스치는 잔빛이 한 점 튀었다. 리아는 그 울음을 탁자 쪽으로 가져가지 않았다. 손등으로 보리를 마른 자리에 붙이며 낮게 불렀다.
“보리. 있어.”
보리는 들어가지 않았다. 귀 두 개가 덮개 밖에 남았고, 사슬 쪽을 향한 채였다.

findings.ko: 옆판의 뿔 자국(긴 자국 하나, 짧은 둘, 겹친 하나)이 어느 칸에도 없음. 2칸은 리아 뒤 바위에 긁힘. ‘넷’의 근거가 화면에서 빠짐(p16).

plan.intent: In the damp outpost yard, Ria sees a fresh horn gouge on the first supply cart and keeps the count unspoken. More carts close the yard while the drivers watch only the ledger table. Bori comes out of the bag, aims along the road on the side where a chain had been, and cries a second time with the tail curled to the neck. Ria does not carry that cry to the table; she holds Bori to a dry spot, and both ears stay out toward that road.
plan.staging: Daylight in the damp outpost yard. The chain-side road is the road the first cart came up; no chain is present, and that road was left open only at the bottom. The first cart's side board can face the sun while the cart fills the yard entrance. The second cart is behind it, and the third reaches the eaves shade. Overlapping cargo-cover shadows hide the empty yard stone without moving it. The ledger table is where the drivers look, and one rein hand aims toward it. The bag is with Ria. From there, Bori's nose only needs the direction of that road, and one short forepaw can meet her sleeve. The tail tip can curl to Bori's own neck. The dry spot is wherever the back of Ria's hand presses Bori; both ears can stay outside the cover. The led animal stamping and shaking a feed pouch belongs to the same jammed yard, not another picture. Sweat, wet-sack smell, and the stopped rear wind are conditions of that jam, not further pictures. The bag shake is already finished before Bori is ears first. Distances among Ria, the bag, the table, the stone, and the carts stay open. These are ordered events, not frames: the artist chooses shapes, framing, and vertical reading, and may share a frame only when the later event is still visibly after the earlier one.
uncertainties: ch-4-p-20 and ch-4-p-22 have no speaker tags. text-kiik and text-kku are carried by c3 because ch-4-p-21 continues the cry of the marten who has just come out; another speaker is not named.

ch-4-p-23 does not name whose hand the single light speck touches, and it states no wound and no sustained discharge. The speck is not given a source. The prose places the standing fur and the speck before the press; the press event shows them in one contact.
The dry spot is not located. ch-4-p-25 keeps both ears outside the cover and does not say Bori has left the bag.
ch-4-p-16 does not show a chain or a gate as present, does not show the animal that made the gouge, and does not tie the gouge to the led animal.

ch-4-p-17 does not name the led animal's species, which cart it belongs to, what the second cart blocks, or whose nose meets the smell. The empty yard stone is not identified with any earlier entrance stone.
Doyun and Maren are not named in these units, and the drivers are not identified as the party.

beats.action: The first supply cart fills the yard entrance, sunlight on a damp pale horn gouge in the side board: one long mark, two short marks below, and one overlapping mark at the end where the direction changed.
With those marks already visible, Ria keeps the count unspoken inside her mouth.

The second cart is already behind the first and the third is already under the eaves shade, overlapping cargo-cover shadows hide the empty yard stone, and the drivers look only at the ledger table with one rein hand aimed toward it.
Bori is out of the bag ears first, cover pushed up, nose along the chain-side road, one short forepaw on Ria's sleeve, giving the first cry.
Bori's tail tip curls up to Bori's own neck as Bori cries again toward that same road.
Ria keeps the cry off the ledger table and presses Bori to a dry spot with the back of her hand while cream fur stands on the nape and one light speck touches the back of a hand.

facts.statement: Before the first cart fills the yard entrance, overlapping wheel sounds come along the road in front of the outpost on the side where a chain had been, and a supply cart comes up the road that was left open only at the bottom.

The first supply cart fills the yard entrance. Sunlight catches a horn scrape on the side board: pale inner wood shows, the edges are still damp, the marks are one long mark, two short marks below it, and one overlapping mark at the end where the direction changed, and the place it turned back remains in the wood.
Ria turns that count over only inside her mouth.
A second cart is behind and closes the way behind it, and a third pushes in as far as the eaves shade.
When the cargo covers lay their shadows over one another, the empty stone in the yard is no longer visible.
The animal being led stamps in place and shakes a feed pouch.
Animal sweat and the smell of wet sacks mix at the tip of a nose. Once the carts block the yard, the wind that was leaving toward the rear stops.
The people driving the carts look only at the ledger table rather than at the party. A hand holding the reins stays aimed toward the table, and the yard waits in silence for that place alone.
The bag shakes before Bori pushes the cover up.
Bori pushes the cover up and comes out ears first. The nose points along the road the cart came up, the side where a chain had been. One short forepaw pushes Ria's sleeve.
The cry does not finish as one sound. The tail tip curls up to Bori's own neck, and Bori cries again toward the same direction.
Cream fur on the nape stands, and one speck of light flicks across the back of a hand with a sting.
Ria does not take that cry toward the table. With the back of her hand she presses Bori to a dry spot and calls low.
Bori does not go in. Both ears remain outside the cover, aimed toward the chain side.

moments.action: The first supply cart fills the yard entrance as sunlight catches a damp pale horn scrape: one long mark, two short marks below, and one overlapping mark where it turned.
Ria keeps that count unspoken inside her mouth, the same scraped board still in sight.

The second cart sits behind the first and the third rests under the eaves shade; overlapping cover shadows conceal the empty yard stone while drivers watch only the ledger table, one rein hand aimed there.
Bori comes out ears first under the raised cover, nose toward the chain-side road, one short forepaw on Ria's sleeve, and gives the first cry.
Bori's tail tip curls up to Bori's own neck as Bori cries again toward that same road.
Ria presses Bori to a dry spot with the back of her hand and calls low, cream fur standing on the nape, one light speck on a hand's back.
Both of Bori's ears stay outside the cover, aimed toward the chain side.

review.evidence: Seven panels in four rows. Row 1: a wide shot of covered supply carts drawn by horses arriving at the outpost road under the cliff. Row 2: Lia in profile with her knuckle at her lips and the thought bubble; the yard filled with three covered carts while drivers stand at the ledger counter under the eaves. Row 3: Bori's head out of the bag under Lia's sleeve with the first cry; Bori crying again with the dark-tipped tail curled up behind its neck. units.text: 탁자 뒤의 사람이 장부를 돌려 빈칸을 보여 주었다. 약이 들어간 줄 아래, 동쪽 칸은 비어 있었다. 손톱이 그 칸의 모서리를 두드렸다.
“여기 통행 한 줄이 있어야 대기 수레가 다음 길에 짐을 싣고 나갑니다. 비었다고 적히면 대기 짐까지 실려요. 자국이 있다고 적히면 수레는 이 마당에 붙들어 둡니다.”
셋째 수레의 바퀴가 돌에 걸린 채 삐걱였다. 해는 처마를 넘어 덮개 위로 기울어 있었다. 새벽부터 막혀 있던 행렬이 마당에 겹쳐 선 채 그 칸만 보고 있었다. 뒤에서 또 하나의 굴림이 사슬 쪽 길에 낮게 깔렸다. 줄을 받지 못한 수레가 밤을 세울 자리는 이미 없었다.
도윤은 탁자 밖에 있었다. 뒤편 입구 돌 앞에 무릎을 굽히고, 가죽 조각의 짧은 선을 돌의 금에 겹쳐 보고 있었다. 화살표의 꺾인 각은 비슷했다. 짧은 선은 아직 포개지지 않았다. 돌의 금은 닳아 희미해서, 그는 손톱으로 홈을 더듬었다가 조각을 다시 들었다. 무릎 꿇은 그 자리만 바깥빛을 받고 있었다.

리아가 펜을 오른손에 쥐었다. 손목이 접히며 펜대가 탁자를 굴렀다. 펜은 왼손으로 옮겨졌고, 오른손은 소매 안으로 들어갔다. 옆판의 흠이 다시 눈에 걸렸다. 축축한 속살은 네 갈래였고, 장부의 칸은 하얗다. 넷이라는 수가 혀 끝에 있다가, 대기 더미의 높이 앞에서 도로 들어갔다. 되돌아선 자리, 보리의 울음, 펴지지 않는 손목, 표식을 새긴 손의 이름도 그 더미 앞에서 갈라졌다. 이름은 입안에 걸렸다가 삼켜졌다.
마렌이 자루를 무릎으로 고정한 채 탁자를 보았다.
“리아. 수레가 그 칸만 봐요.”

findings.ko: 1칸: 장부에 없는 표(순번/출발지/통행/비고)와 이름 ‘리우스’, ‘카렌’ 창작. 계획된 텍스트 3개 외 글자 렌더.

plan.intent: In the crowded outpost yard the blank east cell is the passage line a waiting cart needs. Over the open ledger, that line lets the cart load and leave on the next road; written as empty, the waiting cargo loads too; written as traces, the cart stays held in the yard. The third cart's wheel creaks where it is caught on a stone, the sun has passed the eaves onto the covers, and the line blocked since dawn stands overlapped, watching only that cell, while another low rolling comes on the chain-side road behind and a cart still without the line already has no place to spend the night. Outside the table, Doyun kneels in the one patch of outside light and tests the short line of a leather scrap against the worn crack; the arrow's bent angle is similar, the short line still fails to overlap, and he traces the groove and lifts the scrap. At the table Ria takes the pen in her right hand, the wrist folds, the shaft rolls, the pen passes to her left hand, and the right hand goes into the sleeve. The side board's damp inner wood is four branches against the white cell. Four reaches her tongue and withdraws before the height of the waiting pile; the place that turned back, Bori's cry, the wrist that will not straighten, and the name of the hand that carved the mark come apart there, and the name is swallowed. Maren, a sack fixed with her knee, looks at the table and tells Ria the carts are watching only that cell.
plan.staging: Daylight in the damp outpost yard. The ledger is on the table, turned by the person behind it so the empty east cell shows below the entered medicine line, with a fingernail at that cell's corner. Letter the passage rule as that person's speech and keep that person distinct from Ria, Doyun, Bori, and Maren. Ria is at the table with the pen, right hand then left hand, right hand inside the sleeve, and the side-board flaw is visible again from there; its damp inner wood reads as four branches, matching the gouge already on the supply cart in the yard. The ledger cell stays white. The waiting pile has a height before her. The third cart is in the same yard with a wheel caught on a stone. The overlapped procession looks toward that cell. Sun is past the eaves on the cover. Doyun is outside the table, kneeling at the rear entrance stone with the leather scrap against the crack, and only that kneeling place has the outside light. Maren is by the table with a sack fixed under her knee, looking at the table. A low rolling sound is on the chain-side road behind. Distances among table, carts, rear stone, side board, and pile stay open. These are ordered events: a later event can share a frame when it remains visibly later. The artist chooses shapes, framing, and vertical reading.
uncertainties: ch-4-p-27 leaves the speaker unnamed. The words follow the person behind the table, who has no foundation id. text-rule uses narrator so the line is not placed in c1, c2, c3, or c4.
ch-4-p-26 brings in a fingernail on the cell corner after that person turns the ledger, and names no separate owner. The person being shown the ledger is also unnamed.
ch-4-p-29 gives the leather scrap a short line and says the arrow's bent angle is similar. Which surface carries the arrow stays open.
The rear entrance stone, any earlier yard stone, and the stone under the third wheel are separate mentions in the available units.
ch-4-p-28 names the chain-side road. A chain as an object is outside this excerpt. The new rolling is sound from behind and is not an arrival into the yard.

The swallowed name has no letters in ch-4-p-30. The number four is narrated at the tongue and then withdrawn, so text-four is the unsaid count. Bori's cry is one of the things that come apart before the pile; these units give Bori no new action.

Where the waiting pile stands, and whether Ria is physically in front of it, stays open. The entered medicine line has no quoted wording. Which cart cover receives the sun stays open among the covers.
ch-4-p-32 has no speaker tag. Attribution to c4 follows the preceding sentence, the vocative to c1, and the polite ending. During this passage c2 is at the rear entrance stone.

units.text: “마렌 씨. 칸은 제가 적을게요.”
대기 더미가 첫 수레 옆에 쌓여 있었다. 아직 어느 짐칸에도 오르지 않은 자루들이었다. 줄이 무거우면 더미는 마당에 남고, 줄이 가벼우면 확인 전의 굽이로 올라간다. 리아는 더미와, 아직 어긋난 조각과, 덮개 밖의 귀를 한 번에 보았다.
펜 끝이 닿기 직전, 보리가 사슬 쪽으로 또 울었다. 리아는 그 소리를 칸에 넣지 않았다.
“다음 통행은 뒤편 좁은 굽이입니다. 자국은 낡은 것이고, 오늘은 비어 있습니다.”
왼쪽 손으로 쓴 글씨가 기울어 한 줄을 채웠다. 수는 빠졌고, 울음도 빠졌다. 탁자 뒤의 사람이 그 줄을 소리 내어 읽더니, 같은 문장을 쪽지에 베어 리아에게 내밀고, 대기 더미에 분필 표시를 했다.
“통행, 비어 있음. 추가 짐은 아침에 서명한 검 앞에 내리세요. 받는 자리가 거기입니다.”

plan.intent: Ria takes the blank cell in front of Maren while the waiting sacks still sit beside the first cart. A heavy line would leave that pile in the yard, and a light line would send it up to the bend before confirmation, and in one glance she holds the pile, a piece that still fails to match, and an ear outside a cover. Before the pen tip touches, Bori cries again toward the chain side. Ria enters a single slanted left-hand line that calls the rear bend old in its traces and empty today, and she leaves both the count and that cry out of it. The person behind the table reads the line back, copies it onto a slip for her, chalks the pile, and sends the extra cargo to the receiving place in front of the sword that signed in the morning.
plan.staging: Daylight in the damp outpost yard, at the same table where the ledger cell is written. Ria is at the table, pen in the left hand, right hand remaining in the sleeve. Maren is near enough to be addressed. The waiting sacks are piled beside the first cart and remain outside every cargo compartment. From Ria's glance the pile, a still-misaligned piece, and an ear outside a cover can be seen together; distances among table, pile, piece, and cover stay open. Bori's cry is aimed toward the chain side before the pen tip meets the page. The person behind the table is distinct from Ria, Doyun, Bori, and Maren, and stays behind the table while reading the finished slanted line, copying that same sentence onto a slip, offering the slip to Ria, and chalking the waiting pile. The extra-cargo receiving place is the spot in front of the sword that signed in the morning; where that sword stands relative to the table is unspecified. The pile remains in the yard through these actions. The artist chooses framing and the vertical reading order. A later event may share a frame when it stays visibly later.
uncertainties: ch-4-p-33 has no speaker tag. text-offer is assigned to c1 from the vocative to Maren, the offer to write the cell, the pen already in Ria's hand, and polite speech toward an older adult.

ch-4-p-36 has no speaker tag. It is the sentence the person behind the table afterward reads aloud and copies, so text-line is lettered once as the line Ria enters. The later reading repeats that sentence and is not a second wording.
ch-4-p-34 does not name the still-misaligned piece, so it is unresolved whether the piece is the leather scrap, a map fragment, or an object in a particular hand.
The cover that leaves an ear outside is not identified as a bag or a cart cover. Bori is the one who cries in ch-4-p-35; these units give no further body position.
ch-4-p-35 names the chain side as the direction of the cry. A chain as a visible object is not described, and no arrival comes in from that side.
The bend before confirmation in ch-4-p-34 and the narrow rear bend in ch-4-p-36 are not stated to be the same place.
ch-4-p-38 does not identify the sword that signed in the morning as Doyun or as a weapon, and it does not locate that sword.
The chalk mark's shape and any words inside the mark are unspecified. The omitted count in ch-4-p-37 has no digits in these units.
These units give Doyun no new action and give Maren no reply. The heavy-line and light-line outcomes are a standing rule; the pile is not shown traveling.

units.text: 쪽지가 가벼웠다. 리아가 그것을 쥐고 자루 뒤를 따라 걸었다. 자루가 마당을 가로지르는 동안 마렌이 한 발 나섰다가 장갑 낀 손을 접었다. 자기 발치에는 밀가루 하나와 빌린 끈만 남았다.
“그건 제가 맞추는 짐이 아니에요. 수레가 가져갈 거예요.”
자루를 든 사람은 그 말을 지나 뒤편으로 갔다. 도윤의 발치, 입구 돌 옆에 자루가 내려졌고 먼지가 부츠 위로 튀었다. 그는 조각을 돌에서 떼지 못한 채 먼지를 보았다. 짧은 선은 여전히 어긋나 있었다. 수레 쪽을 보고 도윤이 말했다.
“아직입니다. 선이 안 맞아요.”
앞 수레의 사람은 장부 쪽만 보았다.
“지금 이 줄로 나갑니다. 새벽부터 기다린 칸이에요.”
추가 자루가 그 수레의 짐칸으로 올라갔다. 칸이 높아지자, 짐 위에 앉아 있던 두 사람이 발판으로 밀려 내렸다. 한 사람은 모자를 바로잡고 바퀴 옆으로 걸어 내려갔고, 다른 사람은 고삐 밖으로 물러났다. 빈 자리에 자루가 들어찼다. 수레는 내려선 사람들을 마당에 두고 뒤편 입구로 굴러갔다.

plan.intent: Ria follows a light slip behind one sack as it crosses the yard. Maren takes a single step after it and stops, folding a gloved hand, with one flour and a borrowed cord left at her feet, and lets the cart take the cargo. The sack is set in the dust at Doyun's feet beside the entrance stone, the piece still held to the stone and the short line still misaligned, and he tells the cart side that it is not yet. The person of the front cart looks only toward the ledger and declares that this line leaves now, a cell waited for since dawn. The extra sack goes up into that cart, the two people who had been sitting on the cargo are pushed down to the footboard and left in the yard, and the cart rolls on toward the rear entrance.
plan.staging: Daylight in the damp outpost yard. Ria walks behind the sack with the light slip in her hand while the sack crosses the yard ahead of her. Maren is on the yard ground, one step forward and then her gloved hand folded, with one flour and a borrowed cord at her feet. An unnamed bearer, distinct from Ria, Maren, and Doyun, carries the sack past the speech and sets it down at Doyun's feet beside the entrance stone. Dust lands on the boots at that spot. The piece remains on the entrance stone where Doyun has failed to detach it. Doyun's look then goes toward the cart. The front cart's person looks only toward the ledger. After that declaration, the extra sack is up in that front cart's cargo compartment and the compartment is higher. Two unnamed people who had been sitting on the cargo are on the footboard, then one is beside the wheel and walking down, the other is outside the reins, and the sack occupies the place they left. Those who stepped down stay in the yard as the cart rolls toward the rear entrance. Distances among the ledger, the entrance stone, and the cart stay open. The artist chooses framing and the vertical reading order. A later event may share a frame when it stays visibly later.
uncertainties: ch-4-p-40 has no speaker tag. The line is assigned to Maren from her step-and-stop just before it, the cargo wording, and the polite register. Ria is also present behind the sack and also speaks politely to an older adult, so the speaker stays uncertain. The bearer is out of the assignment because ch-4-p-41 sends that person past the speech.
The thing refused in ch-4-p-40 is unspecified. It may be the slip, the sack being carried, or the flour left at Maren's feet.
ch-4-p-39 names one flour and gives no container, so a sack, a loose measure, or another unit all remain open.
ch-4-p-41 puts dust on boots where the sack is set at Doyun's feet. The owner of the boots is unnamed.
The piece remains attached to the entrance stone, and the short line is still misaligned. These units do not say the short line is on that piece.
ch-4-p-45 calls the loaded object the extra sack and names no lifter. It does not state that this is the same sack just set at Doyun's feet.

ch-4-p-44 has no speaker tag. It is lettered as dialogue of the front-cart person because that person has just looked only toward the ledger. That person is unnamed and is distinct from Ria, Doyun, Maren, and the bearer, so the speaker field has no character id.

The cell named in ch-4-p-44 may be a ledger cell or the cargo compartment that becomes higher in ch-4-p-45. The line they leave on may be a written passage line, a queue, or a rope. These units do not define it.
The two people who sat on the cargo are unnamed. These units give Ria, Doyun, and Maren no place on the cart.
These units give Bori no position and no action.
The rear entrance is not identified with any bend named before this excerpt. Where the ledger sits relative to the cart and the entrance stone is unspecified.
ch-4-p-39 shows a gloved hand being folded. Whether the glove is on one hand or both, and the exact shape of the fold, are unspecified.
The compartment becomes higher as the extra sack goes up, and the two sitters are pushed down onto the footboard. No further lifting mechanism is stated.

beats.action: Ria holds the light slip and follows behind the sack as it crosses the yard.
Maren takes one step, folds her gloved hand, and stands with one flour and a borrowed cord at her feet while saying that this is not cargo she matches and that the cart will take it.

The sack-bearer passes that speech, goes toward the rear, and sets the sack at Doyun's feet beside the entrance stone, where dust jumps onto the boots. Still unable to detach the piece from the stone, he looks at the dust, and the short line remains misaligned.
Doyun looks toward the cart and says that it is not yet and that the line does not match.
The person of the front cart looks only toward the ledger and says they are leaving on this line now, a cell waited for since dawn.

The extra sack goes up into that cart's cargo compartment. As the compartment becomes higher, the two people who were sitting on the cargo are pushed down onto the footboard. One straightens a hat and walks down beside the wheel, the other draws back outside the reins, and the sack fills the emptied place. The cart leaves those who stepped down in the yard and rolls toward the rear entrance.

facts.statement: The slip was light. Ria held it and walked along behind the sack.
While the sack crossed the yard, Maren took one step forward and then folded her gloved hand.
At Maren's own feet only one flour and a borrowed cord remained.
The spoken line says that the thing in question is not cargo the speaker matches, and that the cart will take it.
The person holding the sack went past that speech and on toward the rear.
The sack was set down at Doyun's feet, beside the entrance stone, and dust jumped onto the boots.
Doyun looked at the dust while still unable to detach the piece from the stone. The short line was still misaligned.
Doyun looked toward the cart and spoke.
Doyun's spoken line says that it is not yet and that the line does not match.
The person of the front cart looked only toward the ledger.
The spoken line says they are going out on this line now, and that it is a cell waited for since dawn.
The extra sack went up into that front cart's cargo compartment. When the compartment became higher, two people who had been sitting on the cargo were pushed down onto the footboard.
One of the two straightened a hat and walked down beside the wheel. The other drew back outside the reins. The sack filled the place they had emptied.
The cart left the people who had stepped down in the yard and rolled toward the rear entrance.

brief.style: Finished full-color fantasy comic, expressive ink lines, adult cast, daylight in a damp mountain-outpost yard after rain.

moments.action: A bearer carries a sack across the yard; Ria follows with the slip. Maren speaks, gloved hand folded, one flour and a borrowed cord at her feet.
The sack rests at Doyun's feet beside the entrance stone, dust on the boots. Piece still on the stone, he faces the cart and speaks.
The front cart's person looks only toward the ledger and speaks.
The cart rolls toward the rear entrance with the extra sack in its higher cargo, leaving in the yard one person with a straightened hat and one clear of the reins.

units.text: 도윤의 손이 허리로 갔다가 빈 고리만 쥐었다. 손바닥 안에는 고리의 차가운 테두리뿐이었다. 리아가 내민 쪽지를 그가 붙잡았다. 아침에 적은 자기 이름 옆에, 리아의 한 줄이 적혀 있었다. 종이가 주먹 안에서 구겨졌다. 리아의 왼손은 비었다.
바퀴가 표식 돌을 넘었다. 도윤이 조각을 들어 올려도 수레 옆판이 돌의 금과 가죽의 짧은 선 사이를 가렸다. 옆판의 뿔 자국이 햇빛을 스치고 입구 너머 그늘로 들어갔다. 굽이 안쪽에서 바퀴가 벽을 스치는 소리가 한 번 울리고, 이내 짐칸에 가려 낮아졌다.
“리아.”
그가 리아를 보았다. 새긴 손의 이름은 묻지 않았다. 먼저 들어간 수레 쪽이었다.
굽이는 입구 안에서 한 번 꺾인 뒤에 있었다. 조각이 가리키는 좁은 자리와 실제 흙이 포개지는지, 마당에서는 알 수 없었다. 수레는 이미 앞바퀴를 넘긴 채 그늘을 밀고 있었다. 짐칸의 추가 자루가 모서리에 걸릴지, 더 안쪽까지 들어갈지, 보이는 것은 어긋난 조각과 입구를 지나는 옆판뿐이었다.
보리가 사슬 쪽을 보고 작게 울었다. 그 울음은 장부의 어느 칸에도 없었다. 리아의 오른손목이 소매 안에서 접힌 채 펴지지 않았다. 가벼운 문장 위의 잉크가 탁자에서 마르고 있었다.
도윤은 구겨진 쪽지를 펴지 않은 채, 먼저 들어간 수레만 보고 있었다.

findings.ko: 11칸: 장부에 창작 문장 “언젠가 다시 이 길에서…” 렌더. 계획은 리아의 한 줄 글자를 안 줌(p46·p51). 내용 날조.

plan.intent: Doyun's hand finds an empty ring, then closes on the slip Ria offers and crumples it once her line shows beside the name he wrote that morning. The cart crosses the marker stone, hides the gap he is checking, and passes into the entrance shade with one fading brush. He speaks her name and leaves the carved hand's name unasked, while her empty hand, folded wrist, Bori's soft cry, and drying ink stay in the yard, and he watches only the cart that entered first.
plan.staging: Damp daylight in the outpost yard, with sunlight on the cart side panel before that panel enters the shade beyond the entrance. Doyun and Ria are in the yard: his waist carries an empty ring, she offers the slip, then her left hand is empty while the slip is crumpled in his fist. The marker stone and the entrance stay separate. A wheel meets the marker stone while he holds the lifted piece and the side panel stands between the viewer and the interval from the stone's mark to the short line on the leather. The horn mark is on that side panel. The bend is inside the entrance after one turn, and the single wall-brush belongs there, masked by the cargo bed and outside the yard view that can see the misaligned piece and the passing side panel. The cart that entered first is already pushing that shade with its front wheel across an unnamed threshold. The extra sack stays in the cargo bed with its corner contact unresolved. Bori faces the chain side. Ria's right wrist remains folded in the sleeve. A table holds a light sentence whose ink is drying. The chain, the table, the ledger, and the carved hand have no fixed positions. The artist chooses framing and the vertical reading order. A later event may share a frame when it stays visibly later.
uncertainties: The spoken name has no speaker tag. It is assigned to Doyun because he catches the slip and the next unit has him look at Ria. The speaker remains inferred.
Which of his hands meets the ring, and whether that hand later crumples the slip, is unstated. The rim in the open palm and the crumpling fist are successive states.
The morning name and Ria's line have no source glyphs, so the slip carries no invented wording.
The short line on the leather is one end of the hidden interval. These units do not place that short line on the piece he lifts.
The marker stone and the entrance are separate terms. The rear entrance from earlier is not identified here with the bend.
What the front wheel has already crossed is unnamed, and these units do not say it is the same wheel that crosses the marker stone.
Whether the extra sack in the cargo bed catches a corner or goes farther in stays unresolved, so neither outcome is shown.

The subjectless sentence that points toward the cart that entered first has no named subject. It precedes the later moment in which he looks only at that cart, and the two stay sequential. The carved hand is unlocated.

The wall-brush is one sound inside the bend and then lowers behind the cargo bed. The yard view does not show that contact, because the overlap of the piece's narrow place and the soil cannot be known from the yard.
Bori's cry is aimed at an unlocated chain side, and no ledger cell contains it. The ledger's place is unspecified. The cry has no quoted sound.
The cause of the folded right wrist is unstated.
The drying ink belongs to a light sentence on a table. These units do not identify that sentence with the slip. The table is unlocated.
These units give Maren no action and name no driver.

These units do not say whether the address, the cry, the wrist, and the drying ink happen after the brush or while the cart is still passing the entrance. Narration order is kept without adding a cause between them.

Row 1: Doyun's open gloved palm with a small metal ring, a bare hand offering a slip lettered 도윤 | 리아 to a gloved hand, the slip crumpled in a gloved fist beside Lia's right arm. Row 2: Doyun from behind before the marked stone holding a white piece as a cart with a large forked emblem on its side panel passes; the panel and wheel entering the shaded entrance. Row 3: the cart deep in the rock bend; Doyun facing Lia with the balloon 리아.; the cart's rear wheel past the stone in the yard. episodes.title: 뒤를 채운 굽이
episodes.note: 소설(아크 2의 5화)·장면 분할·각색 모두 claude-opus-5-5(Claude Code CLI 2.1.280, effort high, 도구 없음, 요청마다 새 프로세스). 소설은 5패스 12호출, 검증 거절 0회로 자동 커밋. 각색은 사전 검증 차단 3회(s1·s2·s3, 각 1회 자동 재설계 후 통과). 배경 참조 3장 중 ref-outpost·ref-rear-bend는 4화 재사용, ref-bend-ledge(굽이 안쪽)는 이 run에서 새로 생성(generate, medium). 그림 검토도 claude-opus-5-5(오케스트레이터)라 독립 평가가 아님. 5화 소설 워크플로(wf-8998b534)는 9/22 Gemini 시도에서 만들어져 첫 모델 요청(화별 계획)에서 멈춰 있었고(Gemini 답변 반영 0건), 9/23 lore_write 재호출로 같은 워크플로를 이어 모든 답변을 claude-opus-5-5가 냈음. 이때 MCP 서버는 Gemini provider가 추가된 미릴리스 0.3.8 작업 트리였으나 호스트 릴레이 경로는 0.3.7과 같음.

reviewer.note: 5화 호스트와 같은 모델(별도 세션)의 시각 검토. 독립 평가 아님.

units.text: 수레는 굽이를 넘지 못했다. 벽을 스치는 소리가 낮아진 뒤로 바퀴는 다시 구르지 않았다. 해가 산등성이 뒤로 떨어질 때까지 입구 너머 그늘에는 옆판 모서리만 보였다. 이윽고 수레꾼이 걸어 나와 앞바퀴가 벽 턱에 물렸다고 했다. 어두울 때 뒤로 빼다가는 골짜기 쪽으로 미끄러진다고 했다. 사람들은 고개를 끄덕이고 마당의 불가로 흩어졌다. 장부의 줄은 아무도 고치지 않았다.
새벽은 차가웠다. 입구 돌에 이슬이 앉아 금이 더 흐려져 있었다.
도윤의 발 앞에 자루 하나가 내려졌다. 대기 더미의 마지막 자루였고, 겉에 그은 분필 표시가 이슬에 번져 있었다.
"받는 자리가 여기라서요. 서명 부탁합니다."
도윤은 주머니에서 쪽지를 꺼냈다. 밤새 펴지 않은 종이는 주먹 모양대로 접혀 있었다. 그가 무릎 위에서 쪽지를 폈다. 아침에 쓴 그의 이름이 있었고, 그 옆에 리아가 쓴 기울어진 한 줄이 있었다. 오늘은 비어 있음. 도윤은 그 줄 아래에 이름을 한 번 더 적었다. 연필심이 주름에 걸려 획이 끊겼다.
리아는 그 끊긴 획을 보았다.
도윤은 쪽지를 겉옷 안쪽에 넣고 자루를 어깨에 올렸다. 입구를 지나 멈춰 선 수레까지 걸어가 자루를 짐칸 맨 뒤에 얹었다. 그러고는 몰이 자리에 올라앉았다. 수레꾼이 고삐를 쥔 채 그를 올려다보았다. 한쪽 어깨에 흙이 묻어 있었다. 밤새 벽에 기대 잔 모양이었다.
"제가 몰겠습니다. 바퀴 옆에 붙어 주세요."
수레꾼은 말없이 고삐를 넘겼다.

findings.en: Panel 2: Doyun carries a coiled rope at his hip. The source has his rope lost (p38-p40 later rely on the empty belt loop), so the image restores a lost prop.

findings.ko: 3칸: 쪽지가 '이름·서명' 표 양식으로 그려지고 도윤·리아·마렌 이름이 적힘. 원문 쪽지는 도윤 이름과 리아의 기울어진 한 줄뿐. 창작 글자.
findings.en: Panel 3: the slip is drawn as a printed form with invented lettering 이름, 서명, 도윤, 리아, 마렌. The source slip holds only Doyun's name and Lia's slanted line (beat-3); Maren's name and the table are invented, and Lia's line appears only as a caption.

findings.ko: 5·6칸: 이름 없는 수레꾼 자리에 마렌(곱슬 적갈색 머리·벽돌색 조끼)을 그림. 도윤 대사 말풍선 꼬리도 마렌을 가리킴. 인물 대체.
findings.en: Panels 5-6: the unnamed wagon driver is drawn as Maren (curly red-brown tied hair, brick vest), and the text-6 balloon tail points to her. Readers see Maren taking and handing over the reins, which is a character misattribution.

findings.en: Panel 1: the wagon stands fully visible beside the path in the yard rather than showing only a side-board corner in the bend's shade (beat-1).

findings.ko: 4칸: 쪽지는 도윤 무릎 위인데 리아가 종이를 들고 있음. 소매 속 오른손목 표현 없음.

plan.intent: A quiet, cold turn from a stalled night to a morning decision. The wagon failed the bend at dusk and the camp let it sit. At dawn the last waiting sack lands in front of Doyun with a request to sign. He signs a second time beneath Lia's line saying the day is empty, and the pencil breaks on a crease. Lia sees the break. Doyun speaks few words and makes no speech: he loads the sack, takes the driver's seat and asks for the reins. The reader should feel that his choice comes from the physical facts of the stuck wagon and the empty day. The driver's silent handover confirms the choice. The scene closes on hands and reins before the wagon moves.
plan.staging:
Two lighting states only: dim dusk for beat-1, then cold dewy dawn for everything else. Place and time stay within what the excerpt reaches, and nothing moves forward in time past the rein handover.

The outpost's rear entrance separates two areas. The receiving side, where the sack drop and the signing happen, is on the outpost side of the entrance. The wagon sits beyond the entrance, stopped inside a narrow bend with a rock wall on one side and the valley side on the other. From outside, at dusk, only the corner of its side board is readable in the shade. Doyun passes through the entrance to reach the wagon's rear and then its driver's seat. The driver stands on the ground below the seat, close enough to hand the reins up.

At signing, Doyun is low enough to use his knee as a desk; whether he sits or crouches is open. Lia is close enough to see the pencil stroke. Only text-5 must be legible on the slip. The two name entries may read as short handwritten marks without specific lettering.

The requester of text-4 stays off-panel: render text-4 as a voice balloon with a tail to the panel edge, not as a narration caption, and do not attribute it to a visible character.

Continuity: Lia keeps her right wrist folded inside her sleeve and uses only her left hand. Doyun has an empty belt loop with no rope. The driver is a neutral, unnamed figure. Maren, the marten and the deer do not appear, because the excerpt does not place them here.

Do not depict the jammed-wheel mechanism, the ledger's content or a draft animal. The reins may be shown without revealing what they connect to. Panel count, sizes, cameras and composition are the artist's choice. Favor fewer, larger, legible panels, and a single panel may hold more than one beat.
uncertainties: The speaker of text-4 (ch-5-p-4) is unidentified. The schema forces the placeholder speaker 'narrator', but this is a spoken line from an unseen person, not narration. It must not be assigned to Lia, Maren or the driver.
The speaker of text-6 (ch-5-p-8) is not named in the source. Doyun (c2) is inferred because he has just taken the driver's seat and the driver responds by handing him the reins.
Which wheel 'beside the wheel' means, and whether the wagon will go forward or back, are unstated. Show no wheel position or maneuver.
The source mentions reins, which imply a draft animal, but none is named. Do not introduce one, including the deer from the direction.
The mark on the entrance stone (ch-5-p-2) may be a crack, a scored line or a guide mark. Treat it only as a faint mark under dew.
The content of the uncorrected ledger line (ch-5-p-1) is not given. Do not letter it.
When Doyun's first name entry was written is unspecified. The source calls it written 'in the morning', and it is not clear which morning. Present it only as an earlier entry.
The link between the signature request and the slip is implied, not stated. Show the signing without explaining it.
That the driver slept against the wall overnight is the narrator's inference from the soil on the shoulder (ch-5-p-7). Show only the soil.
Who physically set the sack down is unknown. Keep the hands unseen or neutral.
Whether Lia is standing or seated while she watches is unspecified.
The previous preflight review ran on the same host and is not an independent review.

beats.action: Dusk recap: the wagon is stuck past the entrance, and only its side-board corner shows in the shade. The camp gives up for the night and drifts toward the yard fire. The captions carry the stall and the uncorrected ledger. The driver's spoken report is not drawn.

Time cut to cold dawn. The dew-dimmed mark on the entrance stone establishes the morning. The last waiting sack, its chalk smeared, is set down at Doyun's feet, and an unseen person asks for his signature.
Doyun unfolds the fist-creased slip on his knee. Lia's slanted line is legible beside his earlier name, and he signs again beneath it. The pencil catches on a crease and the stroke breaks.
Lia registers the broken stroke. It is a silent reaction, and no words are exchanged.

Doyun commits by acting. The slip goes away and the sack goes onto his shoulder. He goes through the entrance into the bend and loads the sack at the rear of the stopped wagon, then takes the driver's seat. The artist should show the result, not every step.
The driver, reins in hand and soil on one shoulder, looks up at Doyun on the seat. Doyun asks to drive and asks the driver to stay beside the wheel.
The driver passes the reins up without a word. The scene ends on the handover, and the wagon has not moved yet.

facts.statement: The wagon could not get past the bend. After a low scraping sound against the wall, its wheels stopped and did not turn again.
Until the sun dropped behind the ridge, only the corner of the wagon's side board was visible in the shade beyond the entrance.
The wagon driver walked out and reported two things. The front wheel was caught on a ledge of the wall. Backing out in the dark would slide the wagon toward the valley side.
The people nodded and scattered to the fire in the yard. No one corrected the line in the ledger. The ledger line's content is not given.
The dawn was cold. Dew sat on the entrance stone, and the mark on it looked fainter.

Someone set a sack down in front of Doyun's feet. It was the last sack of the waiting pile, and the chalk marking on it had smeared in the dew. An unnamed person said this was the receiving spot and asked for a signature.
Doyun took a paper slip from his pocket. He had not opened it all night, so it was still creased into the shape of a fist. He unfolded it on his knee.

The slip held Doyun's name, written earlier, and beside it a slanted line in Lia's hand (text-5). Doyun wrote his name once more below that line. The pencil lead caught on a crease, and a stroke broke.
Lia saw the broken stroke.

Doyun put the slip inside his outer garment and shouldered the sack. He walked through the entrance to the stopped wagon, placed the sack at the very back of the cargo bed and then sat in the driver's seat.
The wagon driver was holding the reins and looked up at Doyun. One of the driver's shoulders had soil on it.
The line text-6 was said: an offer to drive and a request for the driver to stay beside the wheel. The driver handed over the reins without a word.

brief.style: Finished full-color fantasy comic, expressive ink lines, adult cast; dim dusk opening, then cold dewy dawn at a mountain outpost's rear entrance and narrow bend; Korean lettering verbatim.

moments.action: Dusk at the outpost's rear entrance: beyond it, only a stuck wagon's side-board corner shows in the bend's shade, while people drift away toward the yard fire.
Cold dawn: dew dims a faint mark on the entrance stone; the last sack, its chalk marking smeared, lies at Doyun's feet while an off-panel voice speaks.
The fist-creased slip open on Doyun's knee: his earlier name, Lia's slanted line beside it, and below it his pencil where the new name's stroke breaks on a crease.
Lia, right wrist tucked in her sleeve, looks silently down at the broken stroke on Doyun's slip.
Doyun sits on the stopped wagon's driver's seat in the narrow bend, the sack at the cargo bed's rear; below, the driver, soil on one shoulder, holds the reins and looks up.
Close on hands: the driver silently passes the reins up into Doyun's hand; the wagon still stands.

identity.evidence: No previous scene image was supplied; compared against the character references. Doyun matches (black hair, green coat, sword) but in panel 2 a coiled rope hangs at his hip, although his rope was lost and the direction asks for an empty belt loop. The unnamed wagon driver in panels 5-6 is drawn with Maren's identity (red-brown curly tied hair, brick vest), so Maren replaces the driver.

setting.evidence: Panel 1 uses the rear entrance boulder with the forked arrow and the outpost eaves at dusk; panel 5 uses the narrow bend with the carved handholds on the rock wall and the misty valley, matching the references.

actionTransition.evidence: First scene of the episode; the dusk recap (panel 1) moves to cold dawn (panel 2) and ends on the reins handover (panel 6) with the wagon still standing, as the source orders.

review.evidence: Six panels in a 2-column grid of three rows. Row 1: dusk yard with people at a fire, the entrance boulder and a wagon beside the path; Doyun crouching at dawn beside a sack marked with a chalk X. Row 2: close-up of a lined form on his knee with a pencil; Lia looking down with a paper at the bottom edge. Row 3: Doyun on the wagon seat with the X sack behind him in the bend, a red-haired woman in a brick vest below holding the reins; close-up of a muddy gloved hand passing reins to Doyun's gloved hand. Light moves from dusk to dawn and stays coherent.

units.text: 리아가 발판 옆으로 다가갔다.
"앞은 내가 볼게. 꺾이는 데서 바닥 먼저 짚고—"
"뒤에서 걸어."
도윤은 리아를 보지 않았다. 고삐를 손에 두 번 감고 말의 귀가 어느 쪽으로 돌아가는지만 보았다.
"줄은 네가 적었어. 짐은 내가 받았고."
리아는 입을 열었다가 다물었다. 소매 안의 오른손목은 밤사이 조금도 펴지지 않았다. 앞을 맡으면 왼손 하나로 방패를 세워야 한다. 그 말은 하지 않고 수레 뒤로 물러섰다.
마렌이 벽 쪽인 짐칸 왼편에 붙었다. 수레꾼은 오른편, 골짜기 쪽 바퀴 옆에 섰다. 마렌이 새로 올라온 자루를 손바닥으로 눌러 보고 끈을 한 번 당겼다.
"한 번은 하죠. 이 자루까지는."
두 번은, 이라는 말은 붙이지 않았다.

리아의 허리에서 가방이 들썩였다. 보리가 코로 덮개를 밀고 나오더니 리아의 마른 식량 주머니에 머리를 박았다. 다시 나왔을 때는 말린 고기 한 조각을 물고 있었다. 리아가 손을 내밀자 보리는 몸을 틀어 고기를 등 뒤로 감췄다. 그러고는 가방 가장자리에 앉아 거점 너머, 사슬이 열려 있는 쪽에서 불어오는 바람에 코를 댄 채 혼자 씹었다. 꼬리는 아직 목에 감겨 있지 않았다.
"갑니다."
고삐가 느슨해졌다.

plan.intent: A short, cold standoff over who goes in front, resolved without an argument. Lia offers to lead through the bend. Doyun cuts her off without looking at her and gives a reason built from what each of them signed for: she wrote the line, he received the cargo. The reader learns what Lia does not say. Her right wrist has not straightened overnight, and leading would mean raising a shield with her left hand alone. She swallows it and falls back behind the wagon. The reader should feel that her silence is her familiar error of shielding others by hiding a limit, and that Doyun's refusal is his habit of taking the risky position himself. Maren sets a limit of her own, one attempt, and stops short of saying 'twice'. The scene ends on one word and slackened reins, before the wagon moves.
